verses.english_translation: Content with what comes to him without effort, free from the pairs of opposites and envy, even-minded in success and failure, though acting, he is not bound.

essence.reflection: Accept whatever comes your way naturally. When you stop comparing yourself to others, envy vanishes and peace remains.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः ।
यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते
verses.english_translation: To one who is devoid of attachment, who is liberated, whose mind is established in knowledge, who works for the sake of sacrifice (Yajna), his whole action is dissolved.

essence.reflection: When acts are done purely for the divine, they leave no trace on the subconscious mind.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् ।
ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना
verses.english_translation: Brahman is the oblation; Brahman is the clarified butter; by Brahman is the oblation poured into the fire of Brahman; Brahman verily shall be reached by him who always sees Brahman in action.

essence.reflection: The actor, the instrument, the action, and the result—all are Divine. Seeing this unity transforms mundane work into worship.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते ।
ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति
verses.english_translation: Some Yogis perform sacrifice to the gods alone, while others (who have realized the Self) offer the self as sacrifice by the self in the fire of Brahman.

essence.krishna_guidance: Offer the Self to the Self.
essence.reflection: The highest sacrifice isn't material; it's the surrendering of the individual ego into the cosmic consciousness.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति ।
शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति
verses.english_translation: Some offer hearing and other senses as sacrifice in the fires of restraint; others offer sound and other objects of the senses as sacrifice in the fires of the senses.

essence.reflection: Self-control is a sacred ritual. Every time you hold back an impulse, you are performing a spiritual sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे ।
आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते
verses.english_translation: Others again offer all the actions of the senses and the functions of the life-energy (Prana) as a sacrifice in the fire of the Yoga of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge.

essence.reflection: True discipline is lit by knowledge, not forced by suppression. When you understand, control becomes natural.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे ।
स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः
verses.english_translation: Some offer their wealth, others offer austerity, and others offer Yoga as sacrifice; while the ascetics of rigid vows offer study of scriptures and knowledge as sacrifice.

essence.reflection: There are many ways to give—wealth, effort, study, or meditation. Find the method that suits your nature.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथापरे ।
प्राणापानगती रुद्धा प्राणायामपरायणाः
verses.english_translation: Others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming, and the incoming in the outgoing, restraining the courses of the outgoing and incoming breaths, solely absorbed in the restraint of breath (Pranayama).

essence.reflection: Control of breath leads to control of the mind. The breath is the bridge between the body and consciousness.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति ।
सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः
verses.english_translation: Others, with regulated diet, offer life-breaths in life-breaths. All these are knowers of sacrifice, whose sins are destroyed by sacrifice.

essence.reflection: Discipline in eating is a fundamental sacrifice that cleanses the body and prepares it for higher yoga.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम
verses.english_translation: Eating the nectar, the remnant of the sacrifice, they go to the eternal Brahman. This world is not for the man who performs no sacrifice; how then can he have the other, O best of the Kurus?

essence.krishna_guidance: Live on the Remnants of Sacrifice.
essence.reflection: If you don't give, you cannot receive happiness here or hereafter. A selfish life is a barren life.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे ।
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.english_translation: Thus various kinds of sacrifices are spread out before the face of Brahman (or in the Vedas). Know them all to be born of action, and knowing this, you shall be liberated.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that all Yajnas require Action.
essence.reflection: Spiritual life is not passive; it requires active engagement (Karma). Understanding the mechanics of action leads to freedom.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप ।
सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते
verses.english_translation: Superior is knowledge-sacrifice to the sacrifice with objects, O Parantapa. All action in its entirety, O Partha, culminates in knowledge.

essence.reflection: Material rituals produce material results. Wisdom produces liberation. The ultimate goal of all action is to know the Truth.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया ।
उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः
verses.english_translation: Know that by long prostration, by question, and service; the wise who have realized the Truth will instruct you in that knowledge.

essence.krishna_guidance: Approach a Guru. Serve and Inquire.
essence.reflection: Knowledge cannot be stolen or bought; it must be received with humility. Surrender your ego to learn.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव ।
येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि
verses.english_translation: Knowing which, you shall not, O Pandava, again get deluded like this, and by which you shall see the whole of beings in your Self and also in Me.

essence.reflection: Real knowledge removes delusion (Moha) and reveals the oneness of all life. You, the world, and God are interconnected.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः ।
सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि
verses.english_translation: Even if you are the most sinful of all sinners, yet you shall verily cross all sin by the raft of knowledge.

essence.krishna_guidance: Cross sin with the Raft of Knowledge.
essence.reflection: No matter your past mistakes, wisdom can save you. It is never too late to wake up.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा
verses.english_translation: As the blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge reduce all actions to ashes.

essence.reflection: Knowledge burns up the karma of countless lifetimes. Once you realize the truth, the binding power of the past is destroyed.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति
verses.english_translation: Verily there is no purifier in this world like knowledge. He that is perfected in Yoga finds it in the Self in due season.

essence.reflection: Knowledge is the ultimate cleanser. Keep practicing Yoga, and this wisdom will naturally bloom within you in time.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः ।
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति
verses.english_translation: The man who is full of faith, who is devoted to it, and who has subdued the senses, obtains (this) knowledge; and having obtained knowledge, he goes at once to the supreme peace.

essence.reflection: Faith + Discipline = Knowledge -> Peace. This is the formula. Without faith, the journey cannot begin.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति ।
नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः
verses.english_translation: The ignorant, the faithless, the doubting self goes to destruction; there is neither this world, nor the other, nor happiness for the doubting.

essence.reflection: Doubt is a cancer. It destroys relationships, success, and spiritual growth. A doubting mind finds no happiness anywhere.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसञ्छिन्नसंशयम् ।
आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
verses.english_translation: He who has renounced actions by Yoga, whose doubts are rent asunder by knowledge, and who is self-possessed, actions do not bind him, O Dhananjaya.

essence.reflection: When you act without attachment and know the truth, you are free. Doubts vanish in the light of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः ।
छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत
verses.english_translation: Therefore, with the sword of knowledge, cut asunder the doubt of the self born of ignorance, residing in your heart, and take refuge in Yoga. Arise, O Bharata!

essence.reflection: Don't let doubt linger in your heart. Destroy it with wisdom and stand up to face your life's battle.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि ।
यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम्
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: O Krishna, You praise renunciation of actions, and then again, You praise Yoga (performance of action). Tell me decisively which of the two is better for me.

essence.reflection: It is common to be confused between 'letting go' and 'taking action'. Seek clarity when values seem to conflict.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ ।
तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Renunciation and the Yoga of action both lead to the highest bliss; but of the two, the Yoga of action is superior to the renunciation of action.

essence.reflection: While both paths lead to the same goal, staying in the world and acting selflessly is more practical and beneficial than abandoning the world.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति ।
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.english_translation: He should be known as a perpetual renouncer who neither hates nor desires; for he who is free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed, is easily set free from bondage.

essence.krishna_guidance: Be a Nitya Sannyasi (Eternal Renouncer) internally.
essence.reflection: Renunciation is a state of mind, not a dress code. If you have no hate and no craving, you are free, regardless of your job.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
साङ्ख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः ।
एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्
verses.english_translation: Children, not the wise, speak of Sankhya (knowledge) and Yoga (action) as distinct; he who is truly established in one obtains the fruit of both.

essence.reflection: Theory (Sankhya) and Practice (Yoga) are two sides of the same coin. Don't get caught up in academic distinctions.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यत्साङ्ख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते ।
एकं साङ्ख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.english_translation: That place which is reached by the Sankhyas (Jnanis) is also reached by the Yogis (Karma Yogis). He sees truly who sees Sankhya and Yoga as one.

essence.krishna_guidance: Understand that the Goal is One.
essence.reflection: Whether you meditate in a cave or work in an office, if the ego is dissolved, the destination (Moksha) is the same.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः ।
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति
verses.english_translation: But renunciation, O mighty-armed, is hard to attain without Yoga; the sage armed with Yoga attains Brahman quickly.

essence.krishna_guidance: Practice Yoga to make Renunciation possible.
essence.reflection: You cannot simply drop your burdens (Sannyasa) without building the spiritual muscle (Yoga) to sustain that state.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः ।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते
verses.english_translation: He who is devoted to the path of action, whose mind is quite pure, who has conquered the self, who has subdued his senses, and who realizes his Self as the Self in all beings, though acting, is not tainted.

essence.krishna_guidance: See your Self in All Beings.
essence.reflection: When you realize that the same life force within you exists in everyone else, your actions become naturally harmless and pure.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नैव किञ्चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित् ।
पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन्
verses.english_translation: The knower of Truth, being centered in the Self, should think, 'I do nothing at all'—though seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, going, sleeping, breathing...

essence.krishna_guidance: Adopt the attitude: 'I do nothing' (Naiva kinchit karomi).
essence.reflection: The body and senses perform their functions automatically. The Witness (Soul) does not participate in the mechanics of life.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्
verses.english_translation: ...speaking, letting go, seizing, opening and closing the eyes—convinced that it is the senses that move among the sense objects.

essence.reflection: Detach your identity from biological reflexes and actions. Watch your body act as if you were watching a stranger.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
verses.english_translation: He who performs actions, offering them to Brahman and abandoning attachment, is not tainted by sin, just as a lotus leaf is not tainted by water.

essence.reflection: Be in the world, but not of it. Let experiences touch you (like water on a leaf) without wetting or staining your soul.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि ।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये
verses.english_translation: Yogis, having abandoned attachment, perform actions merely by the body, mind, intellect, and senses, entirely for the purification of the self.

essence.reflection: Work is a detergent. When done without ego, it scrubs away the impurities of the mind.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् ।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते
verses.english_translation: The steady-minded one, having abandoned the fruit of action, attains eternal peace; the unsteady one, impelled by desire and attached to the fruit, is bound.

essence.krishna_guidance: Abandon fruit to find Eternal Peace.
essence.reflection: Peace is the natural result of dropping the anxiety about 'what will I get?'. Desire binds; letting go frees.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी ।
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्
verses.english_translation: Renouncing all actions by the mind, the self-controlled embodied one rests happily in the nine-gated city, neither acting nor causing others to act.

essence.krishna_guidance: Rest happily in the Nine-Gated City (Body).
essence.reflection: View your body as a house (city) you inhabit. You are the resident, not the house itself.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः ।
न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते
verses.english_translation: The Lord creates neither the agency (doership) nor the actions of the world, nor the union with the fruit of action; it is Nature that acts.

essence.reflection: God doesn't micromanage your ego. Your own nature drives your actions. Don't blame God for your karma.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः ।
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः
verses.english_translation: The Lord takes neither the demerit nor even the merit of any; knowledge is enveloped by ignorance, thereby beings are deluded.

essence.reflection: The Divine is a neutral observer. Our suffering comes from our own ignorance (Avidya) covering our innate wisdom.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः ।
तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्
verses.english_translation: But to those whose ignorance is destroyed by the knowledge of the Self, that knowledge, like the sun, reveals the Supreme.

essence.krishna_guidance: Let Knowledge shine like the Sun.
essence.reflection: Just as sunrise instantly dispels the darkest night, true realization instantly destroys lifetimes of ignorance.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः ।
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः
verses.english_translation: Thinking of That, merging their Self in That, established in That, and devoted to That alone, they go to the state from which there is no return, their sins washed away by knowledge.

essence.reflection: Total immersion in the Divine—intellect, mind, and ego—is the requirement for total liberation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि ।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः
verses.english_translation: The wise look with equal eye on a Brahmana endowed with learning and humility, on a cow, on an elephant, and even on a dog and an outcast.

essence.reflection: True wisdom is seeing the same Life Force (Soul) within the highest scholar and the lowliest creature.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इहैव तैर्जितः स्र्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः ।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः
verses.english_translation: Even here (in this life) creation is conquered by those whose minds are established in equality. Brahman is spotless and equal; therefore, they are established in Brahman.

essence.reflection: You don't need to die to find heaven. If your mind is established in equality, you are living in the Divine right now.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् ।
स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितः
verses.english_translation: He who knows Brahman, being established in Brahman, and with undeluded intellect, does not rejoice on obtaining what is pleasant nor grieve on obtaining what is unpleasant.

essence.reflection: Emotional highs and lows are signs of delusion. A steady intellect (Sthira-buddhi) remains flat-lined in bliss.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम् ।
स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते
verses.english_translation: He whose self is unattached to external contacts and finds happiness in the Self, with his self engaged in the meditation of Brahman, attains endless bliss.

essence.reflection: Happiness isn't out there; it's in here. Detach from the sensory world to tap into the reservoir of joy within.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते ।
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः
verses.english_translation: The enjoyments that are born of contacts are only generators of pain, for they have a beginning and an end, O son of Kunti. The wise do not rejoice in them.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that Sensory Pleasures are Wombs of Pain.
essence.reflection: Every pleasure born from contact carries the seed of pain within it because it is temporary. Wisdom is seeing the hangover before the party.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात् ।
कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः
verses.english_translation: He who is able, while still here in this world, to withstand, before the liberation from the body, the impulse born of desire and anger, he is a Yogi, he is a happy man.

essence.krishna_guidance: Withstand the Impulse (Vegam) of Desire and Anger.
essence.reflection: The true test of strength is not fighting others, but holding your ground against the internal tsunami of emotions.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
योऽन्तः सुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः ।
स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति
verses.english_translation: He who is happy within, who rejoices within, and who is illuminated within, that Yogi attains absolute freedom (Brahma-nirvana), becoming Brahman.

essence.reflection: Stop looking for the light at the end of the tunnel. Be the light. True joy is an inside job.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः ।
छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.english_translation: The Rishis obtain absolute freedom (Brahma-nirvana), whose sins have been destroyed, whose dualities are torn asunder, who are self-controlled, and intent on the welfare of all beings.

essence.krishna_guidance: Rejoice in the Welfare of All (Sarva-bhuta-hite).
essence.reflection: Enlightenment isn't selfish. The highest sages are actively engaged in the good of all living creatures.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम् ।
अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्
verses.english_translation: Absolute freedom (Brahma-nirvana) exists on all sides for those self-controlled ascetics who are free from desire and anger, who have controlled their thoughts, and who have realized the Self.

essence.reflection: For the one who has conquered desire and anger, peace isn't a destination; it is the very atmosphere they breathe.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्वाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः ।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ
verses.english_translation: Shutting out all external contacts and fixing the gaze between the eyebrows, equalizing the outgoing and incoming breaths moving within the nostrils...

essence.reflection: Physical stillness and breath control are the tools to disconnect from the outer world and enter the inner sanctum.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः ।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः
verses.english_translation: ...with senses, mind, and intellect ever controlled, having liberation as his supreme goal, free from desire, fear, and anger—the sage is verily liberated forever.

essence.reflection: Freedom isn't something that happens after death. You are free now if you master your mind and drop fear.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् ।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति
verses.english_translation: Knowing Me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the Great Lord of all worlds, and the Friend of all beings, he attains peace.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know Me as the Friend of All (Suhridam Sarva-bhutanam).
essence.reflection: You are never alone. The Supreme Lord is your intimate friend and well-wisher. Knowing this brings ultimate peace.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः ।
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: He who performs his bounden duty without depending on the fruit of action—he is a Sannyasi (renunciate) and a Yogi, not he who is without fire and without action.

essence.krishna_guidance: Perform duty without depending on the Fruit.
essence.reflection: True renunciation is mental, not external. You don't become a Yogi by just giving up your job or rituals; you become one by giving up the attachment to rewards.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव ।
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन
verses.english_translation: Do you know that which they call renunciation to be Yoga, O Pandava? For no one becomes a Yogi who has not renounced the desire for results (Sankalpa).

essence.reflection: Yoga (Action) and Sannyasa (Renunciation) are the same at the core. Both require giving up the selfish imagination of the mind.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते ।
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते
verses.english_translation: For the sage who wishes to attain to Yoga, action is said to be the means; for the same sage who has attained to Yoga, inaction (quiescence) is said to be the means.

essence.krishna_guidance: Act if you are a beginner; Be Still if you are an adept.
essence.reflection: Don't stop working prematurely. You must work through your karma to reach the stage where natural stillness becomes your path.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते ।
सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते
verses.english_translation: When a man is not attached to sense objects or to actions, having renounced all thoughts of the world, then he is said to have attained to Yoga.

essence.reflection: The sign of spiritual maturity is not having a busy schedule of desires. It is the freedom from the need to chase objects or actions.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः
verses.english_translation: Let a man lift himself by his own Self alone; let him not lower himself. For this Self alone is the friend of oneself, and this Self alone is the enemy of oneself.

essence.krishna_guidance: Elevate Yourself. Do not degrade yourself.
essence.reflection: You are your own best friend and your own worst enemy. No one can save you or damn you but you. Take responsibility.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य yeनात्मैवात्मना जितः ।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्
verses.english_translation: The Self is the friend of the self for him who has conquered himself by the Self; but to the unconquered self, this Self stands in the position of an enemy like the (external) foe.

essence.reflection: If you control your mind, it is your greatest ally. If your mind controls you, it is your destroyer.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः ।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः
verses.english_translation: The Supreme Self is balanced in a self-controlled man who is peaceful, in heat and cold, in pleasure and pain, and in honor and dishonor.

essence.reflection: When the water of the mind is still (calm amidst storms), the reflection of the Divine (Paramatma) is clearly seen.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः ।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः
verses.english_translation: The Yogi who is satisfied with knowledge and wisdom, who remains unshaken, who has conquered the senses, to whom a lump of earth, a stone, and gold are the same, is said to be harmonized.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Gold and Stone as the same.
essence.reflection: Value comes from the mind, not the object. A realized soul sees the same atomic essence in gold and dirt, removing greed.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु ।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते
verses.english_translation: He who is of the same mind to the good-hearted, friends, enemies, the indifferent, the neutral, the hateful, the relatives, the righteous, and the unrighteous, excels.

essence.reflection: It's easy to love friends. The yogi excels by looking at enemies, sinners, and saints with the same compassionate eye.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः
verses.english_translation: Let the Yogi try constantly to keep the mind steady, remaining in solitude, alone, with the mind and body controlled, free from hope and greed.

essence.reflection: Meditation requires an environment free from distraction. You must be alone (Ekaki) to find the All.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्
verses.english_translation: Having established a firm seat for himself in a clean place, not too high nor too low, covered with a cloth, a skin, and kusha grass, one over the other...

essence.reflection: Preparation is key. A stable environment (Asana) supports a stable mind. The physical setup reflects inner intention.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये
verses.english_translation: ...There, making the mind one-pointed, with the actions of the mind and the senses controlled, let him, seated on the seat, practice Yoga for the purification of the self.

essence.reflection: The purpose of meditation isn't stress relief; it is 'Atma-vishuddhaye'—the purification of the Self from ego and illusion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः ।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्
verses.english_translation: Let him hold the body, head, and neck erect and still, gazing at the tip of his nose, without looking around.

essence.krishna_guidance: Hold the body Still and Erect.
essence.reflection: Posture affects the mind. A straight spine allows energy to flow freely, aiding concentration.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः
verses.english_translation: Serene-minded, fearless, firm in the vow of celibacy, having controlled the mind, thinking on Me and balanced, let him sit, having Me as the Supreme Goal.

essence.reflection: Mechanical meditation is not enough. It must be infused with fearlessness, purity (Brahmacharya), and devotion to the Highest.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः ।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति
verses.english_translation: Thus, always keeping the mind balanced, the Yogi, with the mind controlled, attains the Peace abiding in Me, which culminates in Nirvana (liberation).

essence.reflection: The result of disciplined practice is not just relaxation, but a profound, transcendental peace that resides in the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न च अतिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन
verses.english_translation: Verily Yoga is not possible for him who eats too much, nor for him who does not eat at all; nor for him who sleeps too much, nor for him who is (always) awake, O Arjuna.

essence.reflection: The 'Middle Path' is essential. Torturing the body or indulging it both destroy the ability to meditate.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा
verses.english_translation: Yoga becomes the destroyer of pain for him who is regulated in food and recreation, who is regulated in actions, and who is regulated in sleeping and waking.

essence.reflection: Balance in daily life (eating, sleeping, working) is the foundation for spiritual heights. A chaotic life leads to a chaotic mind.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा
verses.english_translation: When the perfectly controlled mind rests in the Self only, free from longing for all (objects of) desire, then it is said: 'He is united (Yuktah).'

essence.krishna_guidance: Rest the mind in the Self.
essence.reflection: Success in Yoga is defined by where the mind rests. Does it rest in worry, or does it rest in the Self?

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः
verses.english_translation: As a lamp placed in a windless spot does not flicker—to such is compared the Yogi of controlled mind, practicing Yoga in the Self.

essence.reflection: A steady flame illuminates perfectly. A steady mind illuminates the Truth. The 'wind' is desire; remove it to steady the flame.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया ।
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति
verses.english_translation: When the mind, restrained by the practice of Yoga, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the Self, he is satisfied in his own Self...

essence.reflection: The goal of restraint is not emptiness, but the fullness of seeing one's true nature.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः
verses.english_translation: ...When he (the Yogi) feels that infinite bliss, which can be grasped by the (pure) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never moves from the Reality.

essence.reflection: Spiritual joy is beyond the senses. Once you taste it, worldly pleasures seem tasteless, and you never wander again.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचालयते
verses.english_translation: Having obtained which, he regards no other gain superior to it; wherein established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow.

essence.reflection: Imagine a state where even the greatest tragedy cannot shake you. That resilience is the promise of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा
verses.english_translation: Let that be known by the name of Yoga, the severance from the union with pain. This Yoga should be practiced with determination and with an undesponding mind.

essence.reflection: Yoga is defined as the 'separation from union with pain'. Don't be depressed by initial failures; keep going.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः ।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः
verses.english_translation: Abandoning without reserve all desires born of Sankalpa (thought/imagination), and completely restraining the whole group of senses by the mind from all sides...

essence.krishna_guidance: Abandon all Desires born of imagination.
essence.reflection: Desire starts with imagination. Nip it in the bud by controlling your thoughts before they become cravings.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्
verses.english_translation: Little by little let him attain quietude by the intellect held firmly; having made the mind establish itself in the Self, let him not think of anything.

essence.reflection: Patience is key. You cannot silence the mind instantly. Use your intellect (Buddhi) to gently guide the mind to silence.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्
verses.english_translation: From whatever cause the restless and unsteady mind wanders away, from that let him restrain it and bring it back under the control of the Self alone.

essence.krishna_guidance: Bring it back. Again and again.
essence.reflection: Meditation is the act of bringing the wandering mind back. Do not get frustrated by the wandering; the practice is the return.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् ।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्
verses.english_translation: Supreme Bliss verily comes to this Yogi, whose mind is peaceful, whose passion is quieted, who is free from sin, and who has become Brahman.

essence.reflection: When the dust of passion (Rajas) settles, what remains is the pure joy of the Soul.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः ।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते
verses.english_translation: The Yogi, always engaging the mind thus (in the practice of Yoga), freed from sins, easily enjoys the Infinite Bliss of contact with Brahman.

essence.reflection: Spiritual practice removes the friction of sin/karma, making the experience of God easy and natural.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः
verses.english_translation: He who is harmonized by Yoga sees the Self abiding in all beings and all beings in the Self; he sees the same everywhere.

essence.reflection: This is the vision of unity. Separation is an illusion; the same consciousness looks out through every pair of eyes.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
verses.english_translation: He who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me, he never becomes separated from Me, nor do I become separated from him.

essence.reflection: If you look for God in everything, you will never be lonely. You are always in His presence, and He is always with you.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते
verses.english_translation: He who, being established in unity, worships Me who dwells in all beings, that Yogi abides in Me, whatever his mode of life.

essence.reflection: Lifestyle doesn't matter (monk or householder); what matters is the internal state of unity with the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः
verses.english_translation: He who, through the likeness of the Self, sees equality everywhere, be it pleasure or pain, he is regarded as the highest Yogi, O Arjuna.

essence.reflection: The Golden Rule: Treat others' pain and joy as if they were your own. This sensitivity is the hallmark of the highest Yogi.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन ।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम्
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: This Yoga of equanimity taught by You, O Madhusudana, I do not see its enduring continuity because of the restlessness (of the mind).

essence.reflection: Arjuna voices the universal complaint: 'Ideally, I want peace, but my mind is too crazy to stay there.'

verses.sanskrit_verse:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम् ।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्
verses.english_translation: For the mind is restless, turbulent, strong, and unyielding, O Krishna; I deem it as difficult to control as the wind.

essence.reflection: The mind is 'turbulent and strong'. Acknowledging the difficulty of the task is the first step to overcoming it.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Undoubtedly, O mighty-armed one, the mind is difficult to control and restless; but by practice and by dispassion it may be restrained.

essence.reflection: The cure for a restless mind is two-fold: Constant practice (pulling it back) and detachment (not valuing what it chases).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः
verses.english_translation: I think Yoga is hard to be attained by one of uncontrolled self; but the self-controlled, striving one can attain it by (proper) means.

essence.reflection: Yoga isn't impossible; it's just impossible without self-control. With the right effort, success is guaranteed.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः ।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: He who is unable to control himself though possessed of faith, whose mind wanders away from Yoga, what end does he meet, having failed to attain perfection in Yoga, O Krishna?

essence.reflection: The fear of failure is common. 'What if I try spiritual life and fail? Will I lose both worlds (material and spiritual)?'

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि
verses.english_translation: Fallen from both, does he not perish like a rent cloud, supportless, O mighty-armed, deluded in the path of Brahman?

essence.reflection: Arjuna fears being a 'rent cloud'—belonging nowhere. It is the existential dread of the seeker.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते
verses.english_translation: This doubt of mine, O Krishna, please dispel completely; because it is not possible for any but You to dispel this doubt.

essence.reflection: Only Supreme Wisdom can answer questions about life after death and the law of karma.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: O Partha, neither in this world nor in the next is there destruction for him; for never does anyone who does good, O My son, tread the path of woe.

essence.reflection: This is the assurance: No good effort is ever wasted. The universe protects those who try to be good. You are safe.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः ।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते
verses.english_translation: Having attained to the worlds of the righteous and having dwelt there for everlasting years, he who fell from Yoga is reborn in a house of the pure and wealthy.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that you get a Second Chance.
essence.reflection: Even if you fail, your spiritual credit is carried forward. You earn a conducive environment for your next attempt.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्
verses.english_translation: Or he is born in a family of wise Yogis only; verily a birth like this is very difficult to obtain in this world.

essence.reflection: To be born into a family of wisdom is a greater blessing than wealth. It is the fast track to liberation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन
verses.english_translation: There he recovers the characteristics belonging to his former body, and with these he again labors for perfection, O joy of the Kurus.

essence.krishna_guidance: Pick up where you left off.
essence.reflection: We don't start from zero in each life. We resume our journey exactly where we stopped. Spiritual progress is permanent.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते
verses.english_translation: By that very former practice he is borne on in spite of himself. Even he who merely wishes to know Yoga goes beyond the Brahmic word (Vedic rituals).

essence.reflection: Your past habits will pull you towards the Truth even if you try to resist. Positive karma acts like a magnet drawing you home.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः ।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.english_translation: But the Yogi who strives with assiduity, purified from sins and perfected through many births, reaches then the Supreme Goal.

essence.reflection: Evolution takes time (many births). Don't be impatient. Keep cleaning the mirror of the heart, and one day you will see the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः ।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन
verses.english_translation: The Yogi is thought to be superior to the ascetics and even superior to men of knowledge (obtained through the study of Shastras); he is also superior to men of action; therefore, be a Yogi, O Arjuna!

essence.reflection: Yoga (union with the Divine) is the highest calling, surpassing mere austerity, book learning, or rituals.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः
verses.english_translation: And of all Yogis, he who with the inner self merged in Me, with Shraddha (faith), worships Me, is considered by Me to be the most devout.

essence.reflection: The culmination of all Yoga is Bhakti (Love). To love the Divine with all your heart is the highest state of existence.

chapters.title: Jnana Vijnana Yoga
chapters.subtitle: The Yoga of Knowledge and Realization

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः ।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: O Partha, hear how you shall know Me in full, free from doubt, with your mind attached to Me and taking refuge in Me, practicing Yoga.

essence.reflection: Knowledge isn't just intellectual; it starts with attachment to the Divine. When you love the subject, learning becomes effortless.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते
verses.english_translation: I shall declare to you in full this knowledge combined with realization, which being known, nothing more here remains to be known.

essence.reflection: There is a 'Master Key' of knowledge. Knowing the Source explains everything else. Seek that which solves all puzzles.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
verses.english_translation: Among thousands of men, one perchance strives for perfection; and even among those who strive and are perfect, one perchance knows Me in truth.

essence.krishna_guidance: Value the Rarity of this pursuit.
essence.reflection: Spiritual realization is the PhD of life. Few enroll, and fewer graduate. Do not be discouraged by the difficulty; be inspired by the exclusivity of the goal.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा
verses.english_translation: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and ego—this is My eightfold divided nature (Prakriti).

essence.reflection: Everything you see (matter) and everything you think with (mind/intellect) is just 'Nature' (Prakriti). It is the hardware, not the user.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्
verses.english_translation: This is the inferior nature. But different from it, know, O mighty-armed, My higher nature, the very life-element (Jiva), by which this world is upheld.

essence.reflection: You are not the dead matter (body/mind); you are the living spark (Jiva) that activates the machine. Identify with the operator, not the machine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा
verses.english_translation: Know that these two (natures) are the womb of all beings. I am the origin and the dissolution of the whole universe.

essence.krishna_guidance: See God as the Source and End.
essence.reflection: Just as waves come from the ocean and return to it, all existence rises from the Divine and dissolves back into It.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय ।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.english_translation: There is nothing whatsoever higher than Me, O Dhananjaya. All this is strung on Me, as clusters of gems on a string.

essence.krishna_guidance: See the String (Sutra) holding life together.
essence.reflection: We look different like separate beads, but the invisible string (God) supports and connects us all. Without the string, we would scatter.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु
verses.english_translation: I am the taste in water, O son of Kunti; I am the radiance in the moon and the sun; I am the syllable Om in all the Vedas; sound in ether, and manliness in men.

essence.reflection: Don't look for God as an object. Look for Him as the 'is-ness' of things—the wetness of water, the light of the sun.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु
verses.english_translation: I am the sweet fragrance in the earth and the brilliance in the fire; I am the life in all beings and the austerity in ascetics.

essence.reflection: That which keeps you alive (Jivanam) and that which makes fire burn (Tejas) is the same Divine energy.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्
verses.english_translation: Know Me, O Partha, as the eternal seed of all beings; I am the intelligence of the intelligent and the splendor of the splendid.

essence.krishna_guidance: I am the Eternal Seed (Bijam Sanatanam).
essence.reflection: Your intelligence isn't yours; it is borrowed light from the Supreme. The seed of your existence lies in the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् ।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ
verses.english_translation: I am the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion. In beings, I am desire not contrary to Dharma, O best of the Bharatas.

essence.reflection: Desire itself is not bad if it aligns with Dharma (e.g., desire to help, desire to learn). God is present in strength used for protection, not oppression.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि
verses.english_translation: Whatever states of being there may be—Sattvic, Rajasic, or Tamasic—know that they all proceed from Me alone. I am not in them, but they are in Me.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know I am the Source, but Unattached.
essence.reflection: The screen (God) allows the movie (creation) to play but is not affected by the movie's tragedy or comedy. The gunas are in Him, but He is free of them.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: Deluded by these three states composed of the Gunas, all this world does not know Me, who am higher than these and imperishable.

essence.krishna_guidance: Wake up from the Delusion of Gunas.
essence.reflection: We are hypnotized by the play of nature (moods, objects, ego). This hypnosis blinds us to the reality behind the scenes.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते
verses.english_translation: Verily, this divine Maya of Mine, consisting of the Gunas, is hard to overcome. But those who take refuge in Me alone cross over this Maya.

essence.krishna_guidance: Surrender to cross the Ocean of Maya.
essence.reflection: You cannot fight the illusion with your own mind (which is part of the illusion). You need the Creator's hand to pull you out.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः
verses.english_translation: The evil-doers, the deluded, the lowest of men, do not seek Me; they whose discrimination has been stolen by Maya and who have taken to the nature of demons.

essence.reflection: It is considered unintelligent to trust the temporary illusion over the eternal reality. Evil actions dull the intellect, preventing surrender.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ
verses.english_translation: Four kinds of virtuous men worship Me, O Arjuna: the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the wise, O best of the Bharatas.

essence.reflection: People turn to God for 4 reasons: Pain (Arto), Greed (Artharthi), Curiosity (Jijnasu), or Love/Wisdom (Jnani). All are good, but Wisdom is best.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते ।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
verses.english_translation: Of them, the wise, ever steadfast and devoted to the One, excels; for I am exceedingly dear to the wise, and he is dear to Me.

essence.reflection: A wise person loves God not for what God can give (money/relief), but for who God is. This unconditional love is mutual.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
verses.english_translation: Noble indeed are all these; but the wise man, I deem as My very Self; for, steadfast in mind, he is established in Me alone as the Supreme Goal.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that the Wise one is My Self.
essence.reflection: God appreciates all who come to Him, but He identifies completely with those who want nothing but Him.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते ।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः
verses.english_translation: At the end of many births, the man of wisdom takes refuge in Me, realizing that 'Vasudeva (God) is all'. Such a great soul is very rare.

essence.reflection: This is the final realization after eons of searching: Everything is God. Finding a person who truly lives this truth is rare.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
verses.english_translation: Those whose wisdom has been rent away by various desires, go to other gods, following various rules and regulations, impelled by their own nature.

essence.krishna_guidance: Don't let desires steal your Wisdom.
essence.reflection: When we want specific material things, we invent specific rituals or 'gods' (powers) to get them. This is transaction, not devotion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्
verses.english_translation: Whatever form a devotee desires to worship with faith, that same faith of his I make firm and unswerving.

essence.krishna_guidance: I strengthen Faith wherever it is placed.
essence.reflection: Faith is a power given by the Divine. Even if the object of worship is limited, the act of faith is supported by God.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान्
verses.english_translation: Endowed with that faith, he engages in the worship of that deity and from it obtains his desires, which are actually ordained by Me.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that I am the Provider.
essence.reflection: You may think your boss, the government, or luck gave you the reward, but ultimately, all sanction comes from the Supreme.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि
verses.english_translation: But the fruit that comes to those of little understanding is temporary. The worshippers of the gods go to the gods, but My devotees come to Me.

essence.reflection: Why work so hard for a reward that expires? Aim for the Eternal. Worship the Supreme to attain the Supreme.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः ।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्
verses.english_translation: The unintelligent think of Me, the Unmanifest, as having manifestation, not knowing My supreme, immutable, and unsurpassed nature.

essence.reflection: Don't limit God to a form or a history. The Infinite cannot be contained in a body, though it may appear through one.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: I am not revealed to all, being veiled by My Yoga Maya. This deluded world does not know Me, the Unborn and Imperishable.

essence.krishna_guidance: Peirce the veil of Yoga Maya.
essence.reflection: God plays hide and seek. He hides behind the illusion of the material world. Only the seeker who looks deeply finds Him.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन ।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
verses.english_translation: I know, O Arjuna, the beings of the past, present, and future, but no one knows Me.

essence.reflection: The Creator knows every actor in the play, but the actors (us) act as if the Creator doesn't exist.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत ।
सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप
verses.english_translation: By the delusion of the pairs of opposites, arising from desire and aversion, O Bharata, all beings are subject to delusion at birth.

essence.reflection: We are born into a world of polarity (hot/cold, like/dislike). This binary thinking is the root of our confusion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः
verses.english_translation: But those men of virtuous deeds whose sin has come to an end, freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship Me with firm resolve.

essence.reflection: Consistency in virtue cleanses the mind. Once the fog of duality clears, devotion becomes steady and unshakeable.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्रामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्
verses.english_translation: Those who strive for liberation from old age and death, taking refuge in Me, realize Brahman, the whole Self (Adhyatma), and all action (Karma).

essence.reflection: The ultimate goal is not just a better life, but freedom from the cycle of decay (aging/death). Seekers of this truth understand the entire picture.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः
verses.english_translation: Those who know Me as the One underlying the material world (Adhibhuta), the demigods (Adhidaiva), and the sacrifices (Adhiyajna), they, with steadfast mind, know Me even at the time of death.

essence.reflection: If you see the Divine in matter, in spirits, and in action throughout your life, you will naturally remember Him at the moment of death.

chapters.title: Akshara Brahma Yoga
chapters.subtitle: The Yoga of the Imperishable Absolute

verses.sanskrit_verse:
किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: What is that Brahman? What is Adhyatma (Self)? What is Karma (Action), O Purushottama? What is declared to be Adhibhuta (Matter)? And what is Adhidaiva (Divine)?

essence.reflection: To understand life, one must first define the fundamental terms of existence: Spirit, Matter, and Action.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः
verses.english_translation: Who and how is Adhiyajna (Lord of Sacrifice) here in this body, O Madhusudana? And how, at the time of death, are You to be known by the self-controlled?

essence.reflection: The most critical question of life is how to face death. The final thought determines the next journey.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Brahman is the Imperishable Supreme; His essential nature is called Self-knowledge (Adhyatma); the creative force that brings beings into existence is called Action (Karma).

essence.reflection: Karma is not just 'work'; it is the creative force of sacrifice that causes all beings to manifest.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर
verses.english_translation: Adhibhuta (Matter) is the perishable nature; Adhidaiva is the Cosmic Person (Purusha); and I alone am Adhiyajna (Lord of Sacrifice) here in this body, O best of the embodied.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me as the Adhiyajna within.
essence.reflection: The Divine is not far away; He resides in the body as the witness and receiver of all actions (sacrifices).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः
verses.english_translation: And whoever, at the time of death, leaves the body remembering Me alone, he attains My nature; there is no doubt about this.

essence.reflection: The final exam of life is death. Remembering the Divine at that crucial moment liberates the soul.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः
verses.english_translation: Whatever object a man thinks of at the final moment when he leaves his body, that alone does he attain, O son of Kunti, being ever absorbed in the thought thereof.

essence.reflection: Your dominant thought in life becomes your last thought at death, which determines your next birth.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः
verses.english_translation: Therefore, at all times remember Me and fight. With mind and intellect surrendered to Me, you shall doubtless come to Me.

essence.krishna_guidance: Remember and Fight (Mam anusmara yudhya cha).
essence.reflection: Spirituality is not passivity. You must perform your worldly duty (Fight) while keeping your mind fixed on the Divine (Remember).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्
verses.english_translation: With the mind not wandering after anything else, made steadfast in the Yoga of constant practice, meditating on the Supreme Resplendent Purusha, one goes to Him, O Partha.

essence.reflection: Consistency (Abhyasa) creates the mental groove that leads the mind naturally to the Divine at the end.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार-
मणोरणीयंसमनुस्मरेद्यः ।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप-
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्
verses.english_translation: Whosoever meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient, the Ruler (of the whole world), subtler than the subtle, the Supporter of all, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun and beyond the darkness...

essence.krishna_guidance: Meditate on the Attributes of God.
essence.reflection: God is both the smallest (subtler than atoms) and the greatest (Ruler of all). He is the Light beyond all darkness.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
ध्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्
verses.english_translation: ...At the time of death, with an unshaken mind, endowed with devotion and by the power of Yoga, fixing the life-breath in the middle of the eyebrows, he reaches that Supreme Divine Purusha.

essence.reflection: The final departure requires technique: Devotion (Bhakti) + Focus (Mind) + Energy Control (Prana).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः ।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं सङ्ग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये
verses.english_translation: That which the knowers of Veda call the Imperishable, which the ascetics free from passion enter, desiring which they practice Brahmacharya, that Goal I will declare to you in brief.

essence.reflection: The goal is so precious that sages practice lifelong celibacy (Brahmacharya) just to attain it.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च ।
मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्
verses.english_translation: Having closed all the gates (senses), confined the mind in the heart, and fixed the life-breath in the head, engaged in the practice of concentration...

essence.reflection: Shut the doors of the senses to the outside world to open the door to the inner world.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.english_translation: ...Uttering the monosyllable Om—the Brahman—and remembering Me, he who departs, leaving the body, attains the supreme Goal.

essence.reflection: OM is the sound vibration of the Absolute. Combining the sound (Om) with the thought (God) leads to liberation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः
verses.english_translation: I am easily attainable by that ever-steadfast Yogi who constantly and daily remembers Me with a single mind, O Partha.

essence.reflection: God is not hard to get; He is 'Easily Attainable' (Sulabhah) for those who never forget Him.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः
verses.english_translation: Having attained Me, these great souls do not take birth again here, which is the place of pain and is non-eternal; they have reached the highest perfection.

essence.reflection: The world is defined as 'Dukhalayam' (House of Sorrow). The only way out is to reach the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन ।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
verses.english_translation: From the world of Brahma down to the lowest world, all are subject to return (rebirth); but having attained Me, O Kaunteya, there is no rebirth.

essence.reflection: Even the highest heavens are temporary vacation spots. Seek the permanent residence (God) where there is no return.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद् ब्रह्मणो विदुः ।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः
verses.english_translation: Those who know that the day of Brahma lasts for a thousand Yugas and that his night ends only after a thousand Yugas, they truly know day and night.

essence.reflection: Human life is a blink of an eye compared to cosmic cycles. This perspective cures petty ego.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके
verses.english_translation: At the coming of the Day, all manifested things proceed from the Unmanifest; and at the coming of the Night, they dissolve into that same Unmanifest.

essence.reflection: The universe breathes. It expands into form and contracts into formlessness. We are part of this cosmic breath.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे
verses.english_translation: This same multitude of beings, coming forth again and again, dissolves helplessly, O Partha, at the coming of Night, and comes forth at the coming of Day.

essence.reflection: Without liberation, we are trapped in this endless automatic cycle of waking and sleeping, birth and death.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति
verses.english_translation: But distinct from that Unmanifest is another Eternal Unmanifest Nature, which is not destroyed when all beings are destroyed.

essence.reflection: There is a reality beyond the cyclic creation. It stands firm when universes crumble.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
verses.english_translation: What is called the Unmanifest and the Imperishable, That they call the Supreme Goal; perceiving which they return not, That is My Supreme Abode.

essence.reflection: This is the final destination. Once you check in here, you never have to check out.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.english_translation: That Supreme Purusha, O Partha, in whom all beings abide and by whom all this is pervaded, is attainable by unswerving devotion.

essence.reflection: The Greatest Reality is accessible through the simplest means: single-minded love (Bhakti).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः ।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ
verses.english_translation: Now I will tell you the time (path) departing at which the Yogis return, and also that departing at which they do not return, O best of the Bharatas.

essence.reflection: Departure isn't random. There are specific cosmic paths that determine the soul's trajectory.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अग्निर्जोतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः
verses.english_translation: Fire, light, day, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path of the sun—departing then, men who know Brahman go to Brahman.

essence.reflection: This path represents illumination and knowledge leading to liberation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते
verses.english_translation: Smoke, night, the dark fortnight, the six months of the southern path of the sun—attaining by these the lunar light, the Yogi returns.

essence.reflection: Good karma (Moon/Smoke) gives you a temporary holiday in heaven, but you must eventually return to school (Earth).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः
verses.english_translation: These two paths, the Bright and the Dark, are deemed to be the world's eternal paths; by the one a man goes not to return, by the other he returns again.

essence.krishna_guidance: Distinguish the Bright and Dark Paths.
essence.reflection: Life offers two directions: Towards Light (Liberation) or Towards Shadow (Rebirth). The choice is constant.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्ययोगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन
verses.english_translation: Knowing these two paths, O Partha, no Yogi is deluded. Therefore, at all times be steadfast in Yoga.

essence.reflection: Knowledge of the afterlife isn't for trivia; it's to keep you focused on Yoga so you don't get lost in the dark path.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्
verses.english_translation: The Yogi who knows this surpasses the meritorious fruits of Vedic study, sacrifices, austerities, and gifts, and attains to the Supreme Primeval Abode.

essence.krishna_guidance: Surpass all rituals; Aim for the Supreme.
essence.reflection: Rituals grant temporary merit. Yoga grants the Eternal. The Yogi is the smartest investor.

chapters.title: Raja Vidya Raja Guhya Yoga
chapters.subtitle: The Yoga of Royal Knowledge & Royal Secret

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: To you who do not cavil, I shall declare this profound secret of wisdom combined with realization, knowing which you shall be free from evil.

essence.reflection: Knowledge is revealed only to those who are free from envy (Anasuyave). cynicism blocks wisdom; openness invites it.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् ।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: This is the King of Sciences, the King of Secrets, the supreme purifier; it is realized by direct perception, righteous, very easy to perform, and imperishable.

essence.krishna_guidance: Practice the King of Sciences (Raja Vidya).
essence.reflection: True spirituality isn't dry theory; it is 'Susukham' (joyful to perform) and gives direct, tangible results.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप ।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि
verses.english_translation: Persons without faith in this Dharma (way to realization), O Parantapa, return to the path of death and rebirth, without attaining Me.

essence.reflection: Doubt is the anchor that keeps you stuck in the cycle of mortality. Faith is the sail that moves you toward the Infinite.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना ।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः
verses.english_translation: All this world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest form; all beings exist in Me, but I do not dwell in them.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me as the Container of All.
essence.reflection: God holds the universe like space holds the clouds. The clouds are in space, but space is not limited by the clouds.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः
verses.english_translation: Nor do beings exist in Me (in reality); behold My Divine Yoga! Bringing forth and supporting the beings, My Self does not dwell in them.

essence.reflection: This is the great paradox: God is everything, yet attached to nothing. He supports the world without getting entangled in it.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय
verses.english_translation: As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, rests always in the ether (space), even so, know that all beings rest in Me.

essence.krishna_guidance: Understand the Analogy of Space and Wind.
essence.reflection: Just as wind cannot exist without space but does not affect space, the universe exists within the Divine without affecting His purity.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्
verses.english_translation: All beings, O Kaunteya, go into My Nature (Prakriti) at the end of a Kalpa (cycle); I generate them again at the beginning of the next Kalpa.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know the Cycle of Creation and Dissolution.
essence.reflection: Creation is cyclic, not linear. We are recycled by the Divine Will through the machinery of Nature.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्
verses.english_translation: Animating My Nature, I send forth again and again all this multitude of beings, helpless by the force of Nature.

essence.reflection: Individual beings are 'helpless' (Avasham) against the cosmic forces of nature until they attain liberation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु
verses.english_translation: These acts do not bind Me, O Dhananjaya, sitting like one indifferent (unconcerned), unattached to those acts.

essence.reflection: If the Creator performs the massive work of creation without attachment, we too can perform our small duties without getting bound.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् ।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते
verses.english_translation: Under Me as supervisor, Nature produces the moving and the unmoving; because of this, O Kaunteya, the world revolves.

essence.reflection: God doesn't work with His hands; His mere presence empowers Nature to act, just as the sun's presence enables life to thrive.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम्
verses.english_translation: Fools disregard Me when clad in human form, not knowing My higher nature as the Great Lord of beings.

essence.reflection: It is easy to mistake the Divine for the ordinary. Don't judge spiritual greatness by external appearances.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः ।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः
verses.english_translation: Vain are their hopes, vain their actions, and vain their knowledge; senseless, they verily are possessed of the delusive nature of Rakshasas and Asuras.

essence.reflection: Life without spiritual grounding is futile. No matter how much 'knowledge' or 'action' one has, without the Divine, it leads to emptiness.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: But the great souls (Mahatmas), O Partha, partaking of My divine nature, worship Me with a single mind, knowing Me as the imperishable source of beings.

essence.reflection: Greatness is defined by the nature you adopt. Shelter under the Divine Nature (Daivi Prakriti) to find focus and devotion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः ।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
verses.english_translation: Always glorifying Me, striving, firm in vows, prostrating before Me, they worship Me with devotion, ever steadfast.

essence.reflection: Devotion is not a part-time hobby. It is a constant stream of praise, effort, and humility.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते ।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.english_translation: Others also, offering the sacrifice of knowledge, worship Me as the One, as distinct, and as manifold, facing in all directions.

essence.reflection: There are many ways to see God: as your own Self (One), as the Master (Distinct), or as the Universe (Manifold). All are valid.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्
verses.english_translation: I am the Kratu (Vedic ritual); I am the Yajna (sacrifice); I am the offering to ancestors; I am the medicinal herb; I am the Mantra; I am the clarified butter; I am the fire; I am the oblation.

essence.reflection: The act of worship, the materials used, and the one worshiping are all manifestations of the same Divinity.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोङ्कार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च
verses.english_translation: I am the Father of this world, the Mother, the Supporter, and the Grandsire; the One to be known, the Purifier, the syllable Om, and also the Rik, Sama, and Yajur Vedas.

essence.reflection: You are never an orphan. The Creator is your Father, Mother, and Guardian. You belong to the universe.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: I am the Goal, the Supporter, the Lord, the Witness, the Abode, the Shelter, the Friend, the Origin, the Dissolution, the Foundation, the Treasure-house, and the Imperishable Seed.

essence.reflection: God is not just a distant ruler; He is your Witness, your Friend, and your Home. Relax into this support.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च ।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन
verses.english_translation: I give heat; I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, O Arjuna.

essence.reflection: Life and Death, Reality and Illusion—all contradictory forces are unified in the Absolute.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्
verses.english_translation: The knowers of the three Vedas, the drinkers of Soma, purified of sin, worshipping Me by sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord of Gods and enjoy in heaven the divine pleasures of the gods.

essence.reflection: Vedic rituals can get you to heaven (a place of high pleasure), but they cannot give you liberation. It is a temporary reward for good behavior.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते
verses.english_translation: They, having enjoyed the vast heaven world, when their merit is exhausted, enter the world of the mortals; thus abiding by the injunctions of the three (Vedas), desiring desires, they attain to the state of going and returning.

essence.reflection: Heaven is like a hotel; you can only stay as long as you can pay (with merit). When the credit runs out, you are evicted back to earth. Seek a permanent home.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्
verses.english_translation: To those men who worship Me alone, thinking of no other, to those ever-united, I carry what they lack, and I preserve what they have.

essence.reflection: If you take care of God's business (devotion), He takes care of your business (needs). This is the ultimate promise of security.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्
verses.english_translation: Even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, they too worship Me alone, O son of Kunti, though by the wrong method.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that all worship reaches Me.
essence.reflection: There is only one Address. No matter what name is on the envelope, the letter goes to the same Source. But direct delivery is better.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते
verses.english_translation: For I am the Enjoyer and the Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in essence, hence they fall.

essence.reflection: Ignorance of the true recipient of your sacrifice leads to limited results. Know the Boss to get the promotion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः ।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्
verses.english_translation: The worshippers of the gods go to the gods; the worshippers of the ancestors go to the ancestors; the worshippers of the spirits go to the spirits; but My worshippers come to Me.

essence.reflection: You become what you worship. If you want the Infinite, worship the Infinite. If you want the limited, worship the limited.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः
verses.english_translation: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water, that I accept, offered by the pure-minded with devotion.

essence.reflection: God is hungry for your love, not your luxury. Simplicity is sufficient. A leaf offered with love is more valuable than gold offered with pride.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् ।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्
verses.english_translation: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever you practice as austerity, O Kaunteya, do it as an offering to Me.
