essence.reflection: Turn your entire life into a Yoga. You don't need to change what you do, just change who you do it for.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः ।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि
verses.english_translation: Thus shall you be freed from the bonds of action yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the Yoga of renunciation, liberated, you shall come to Me.

essence.reflection: When the actor (you) surrenders the action to the Divine, the reaction (karma) cannot locate a target. You become free.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्
verses.english_translation: The same am I to all beings; to Me, there is none hateful nor dear; but those who worship Me with devotion are in Me and I am also in them.

essence.reflection: The sun shines on everyone equally, but only those who step out of the shadows feel its warmth. God is available to all who turn to Him.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् ।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः
verses.english_translation: Even if the most sinful worship Me with undivided devotion, he should be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.

essence.reflection: It is never too late. A resolute turn towards the Divine wipes out a history of sin. Your past does not define your future; your devotion does.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
verses.english_translation: Soon he becomes righteous and attains to eternal peace; O Kaunteya, know for certain that My devotee never perishes.

essence.krishna_guidance: Declare it boldy: My Devotee Never Perishes.
essence.reflection: This is the Divine Guarantee. If you sincerely try to connect with the Divine, you are protected from spiritual ruin.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.english_translation: For, taking refuge in Me, they also, who may be of inferior birth—women, Vaisyas, as well as Sudras—attain the Supreme Goal.

essence.krishna_guidance: The path is Open to All.
essence.reflection: Social status, gender, or birth are irrelevant in spiritual life. The doors of liberation are open to every single soul.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा ।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्
verses.english_translation: How much more then the holy Brahmanas and devoted Royal Saints! Having obtained this transient and joyless world, worship Me.

essence.krishna_guidance: Worship Me in this Joyless World.
essence.reflection: The world is 'Anityam' (temporary) and 'Asukham' (joyless). Don't waste time looking for happiness in a place designed to be temporary. Seek the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः
verses.english_translation: Fix your mind on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. Having thus united your self with Me, taking Me as the Supreme Goal, you shall come to Me.

essence.krishna_guidance: Fix your mind on Me (Manmana Bhava).
essence.reflection: The formula for perfection: Mind on God + Love for God + Work for God + Surrender to God = Union with God.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, listen to My supreme word, which I shall declare to you who are beloved, for your welfare.

essence.krishna_guidance: Listen to My Supreme Word (Paramam Vachah).
essence.reflection: The Divine speaks only for our welfare (Hita-kamyaya). Listening with love opens the heart to higher truths.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः
verses.english_translation: Neither the hosts of gods nor the great sages know My origin; for in every respect I am the source of the gods and the sages.

essence.reflection: The created cannot comprehend the Creator fully. The mind (sages) and senses (gods) cannot grasp what created them.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् ।
असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.english_translation: He who knows Me as unborn and beginningless, as the great Lord of the worlds, he, undeluded among mortals, is liberated from all sins.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know Me as Unborn (Ajam) and Lord (Maheshwaram).
essence.reflection: Liberation comes from right knowledge. Knowing the Divine as the timeless Ruler frees one from the bondage of karma.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः ।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च
verses.english_translation: Intellect, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, happiness, pain, birth or existence, death or non-existence, fear and also fearlessness...

essence.krishna_guidance: Recognize these qualities proceed from Me.
essence.reflection: All psychological states, positive or negative, originate from the Divine energy. Understanding this leads to equanimity.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः ।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः
verses.english_translation: ...Non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, fame, and infamy—all these various attributes of beings arise from Me alone.

essence.krishna_guidance: See the Source of all Attributes.
essence.reflection: Even fame and infamy come from the Supreme. When you see the Source, you stop blaming or praising the individual excessively.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा ।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः
verses.english_translation: The seven great Rishis, the ancient four, and also the Manus, possessed of powers like Me (on account of their minds being fixed on Me), were born of (My) mind; from them are these creatures in the world.

essence.reflection: All forefathers and progenitors originated from the Divine Mind. We are all interconnected branches of one tree.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.english_translation: He who knows in truth this glory and power of Mine is endowed with unfaltering Yoga; there is no doubt about this.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know My Vibhuti (Glory) to attain steadiness.
essence.reflection: Knowledge of God's greatness leads to unshakeable faith. You cannot be devoted to what you do not respect.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः
verses.english_translation: I am the source of all; from Me everything evolves; understanding thus, the wise, endowed with meditation, worship Me.

essence.reflection: When you realize God is the source of everything you love, worship becomes a natural outpouring of emotion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च
verses.english_translation: With their minds and lives entirely absorbed in Me, enlightening each other and always speaking of Me, they are satisfied and delighted.

essence.reflection: Spiritual community (Satsang) is vital. Sharing divine stories and insights creates a shared joy that sustains the devotee.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते
verses.english_translation: To them who are ever steadfast, worshipping Me with love, I give the Yoga of discrimination by which they come to Me.

essence.krishna_guidance: Worship with Love (Priti-purvakam) to receive Wisdom.
essence.reflection: You don't need to be intelligent to find God; you need to be loving. God provides the intelligence (Buddhi Yoga) to the lover.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः ।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता
verses.english_translation: Out of mere compassion for them, I, dwelling within their Self, destroy the darkness born of ignorance by the luminous lamp of knowledge.

essence.reflection: The Guru within lights the lamp. We cannot remove the darkness of ignorance alone; Divine Grace does the heavy lifting.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् ।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Abode, the Supreme Purifier, the Eternal Divine Purusha, the Primal God, the Unborn and the Omnipresent.

essence.reflection: Arjuna acknowledges Krishna not just as a friend, but as the Supreme Reality, validating the teachings received so far.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा ।
असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे
verses.english_translation: All the sages have thus acclaimed You, as also the divine sage Narada; so also Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and now You Yourself say it to me.

essence.reflection: Truth is confirmed by three sources: Scriptures (Sages), the Guru (Krishna), and personal experience (Arjuna).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव ।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः
verses.english_translation: I believe all this to be true, which You say to me, O Keshava; for neither the gods nor the Danavas know Your manifestation, O Blessed Lord.

essence.reflection: Arjuna accepts the teaching 'Ritam' (as Truth). Total acceptance without mental reservation is the mark of a true disciple.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते
verses.english_translation: You Yourself know Yourself by Yourself, O Supreme Purusha, O Source of beings, O Lord of beings, O God of gods, O Ruler of the world.

essence.reflection: Only the Infinite can know the Infinite. We can only know what He chooses to reveal to us.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि
verses.english_translation: You should indeed tell me, without reserve, of Your divine glories by which You exist, pervading all these worlds.

essence.reflection: Arjuna asks to see the Divine not just in the abstract, but in the specific details of the world.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् ।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया
verses.english_translation: How shall I, constantly meditating, know You, O Yogi? In what aspects or things, O Blessed Lord, are You to be thought of by me?

essence.reflection: The mind needs a hook. Arjuna asks for specific forms or qualities (Vibhutis) to anchor his meditation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन ।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्
verses.english_translation: Tell me again in detail, O Janardana, of Your Yoga and Vibhuti; for I am not satiated with hearing Your life-giving nectar.

essence.reflection: Spiritual hunger is insatiable. The more one hears of the Divine, the more one wants to hear. This 'Amrit' (nectar) grants immortality.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Very well, I shall declare to you My divine glories, but only the chief ones, O best of the Kurus, for there is no end to the detail of My expanse.

essence.reflection: The infinite cannot be fully described. Even God condenses His description to the 'Chief' (Pradhanyatah) attributes for our limited understanding.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च
verses.english_translation: I am the Self, O Gudakesha, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and also the end of all beings.

essence.reflection: The closest place to find God is in your own heart. He is the core of your existence.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् ।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी
verses.english_translation: Of the Adityas I am Vishnu; of lights I am the radiant Sun; of the Maruts I am Marichi; of the stars I am the Moon.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me in the Best of Lights.
essence.reflection: Whenever you see brilliance, radiance, or leadership, know it is a spark of the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना
verses.english_translation: Of the Vedas I am the Sama Veda; of the gods I am Indra (Vasava); of the senses I am the Mind; and in living beings I am consciousness.

essence.reflection: God is the melody (Sama), the leader (Indra), the coordinator (Mind), and the very awareness that makes life possible.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् ।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्
verses.english_translation: Of the Rudras I am Shankara (Shiva); of the Yakshas and Rakshasas I am Kubera (Lord of Wealth); of the Vasus I am Agni (Fire); and of mountain-peaks I am Meru.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me in Power and Stability.
essence.reflection: Whether it is destruction (Shiva), wealth (Kubera), energy (Agni), or stability (Meru), it is all Him.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् ।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः
verses.english_translation: Of priests, O Partha, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati; of generals I am Skanda; of bodies of water I am the Ocean.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me in Wisdom and Vastness.
essence.reflection: He is the teacher of the gods (Brihaspati) and the depth of the ocean. Wisdom and depth are divine qualities.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः
verses.english_translation: Of the great Rishis I am Bhrigu; of words I am the one syllable 'Om'; of sacrifices I am the sacrifice of silent repetition (Japa); of immovable things I am the Himalaya.

essence.reflection: The simplest sacrifice is Japa (repetition of the Name). It is the Divine Himself in the form of action.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः ।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः
verses.english_translation: Of all trees I am the Peepul tree (Ashvattha); of the sage-gods I am Narada; of the Gandharvas I am Chitraratha; of the perfected ones I am the Muni Kapila.

essence.reflection: From the sacred tree to the celestial sage, wherever there is holiness, God is present.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्
verses.english_translation: Know Me among horses as Uchchaishravas, born of Nectar; among lordly elephants as Airavata; and among men as the King.

essence.reflection: The best of the species—the king of men, the king of elephants—represents the sovereignty of the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः
verses.english_translation: Of weapons I am the Thunderbolt; of cows I am the celestial cow Kamadhenu; I am Kandarpa, the progenitor; of serpents I am Vasuki.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me in Creation and Power.
essence.reflection: He is the desire that creates life (Kandarpa) and the weapon that upholds justice (Vajra).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् ।
पितृणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्
verses.english_translation: Of the Nagas I am Ananta; of the water-deities I am Varuna; of the ancestors I am Aryama; of the controllers I am Yama (Lord of Death).

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me in Justice and Death.
essence.reflection: God is the ultimate Controller (Yama). Law and Order in the universe are maintained by His will.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् ।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्
verses.english_translation: Of the Daityas I am Prahlada; of reckoners I am Time; of beasts I am the Lion; and of birds I am Garuda (son of Vinata).

essence.reflection: Time consumes everything. God is that Time. He is also the devotion found even in a family of demons (Prahlada).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् ।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी
verses.english_translation: Of purifiers I am the Wind; of the wielders of weapons I am Rama; of fishes I am the Shark (Makara); of rivers I am the Ganges.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me in Purity and Heroism.
essence.reflection: The purifying power of wind and the Ganges, and the righteous might of Rama, are all manifestations of the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्
verses.english_translation: Of created things I am the beginning, the end, and also the middle, O Arjuna; of sciences I am the Science of the Self (Adhyatma Vidya); of those who debate I am Vada (Constructive reasoning).

essence.reflection: Of all knowledge, Self-knowledge is God Himself because it liberates. Honest debate (Vada) to find truth is divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्दः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.english_translation: Of letters I am the letter 'A'; of compound words I am the Dvandva; I Myself am Imperishable Time; I am the Creator (Dhata) facing everywhere.

essence.reflection: God is the foundation of language ('A') and the foundation of time (Akshaya Kala). He supports all from all sides.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा
verses.english_translation: I am the all-devouring Death; I am the origin of those who are to be; and of feminine qualities, I am Fame, Prosperity, Speech, Memory, Intelligence, Firmness, and Forgiveness.

essence.reflection: God is present in the finest human qualities: memory, intelligence, forgiveness. He is also the ultimate leveler: Death.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः
verses.english_translation: Of hymns I am the Brihat-Saman; of meters I am the Gayatri; of months I am Margashirsha; of seasons I am the flower-bearing Spring.

essence.reflection: God is the beauty of Spring and the holiness of the Gayatri mantra. He is the best of every category.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्
verses.english_translation: I am the gambling of the fraudulent; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am determination; I am the goodness of the good.

essence.reflection: Even the cunning of the gambler involves the Divine power of illusion. He is the Victory and the Determination behind it.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः
verses.english_translation: Of the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas I am Dhananjaya (Arjuna); of the sages I am Vyasa; of the poets I am Ushana the poet.

essence.reflection: Krishna identifies Himself with Arjuna. The seeker and the Goal are essentially one.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्
verses.english_translation: Of punishers I am the Scepter (Danda); of those who seek victory I am Statesmanship (Niti); of secrets I am Silence; and of the wise I am Wisdom.

essence.reflection: Silence is the keeper of secrets and the gateway to wisdom. Justice (Danda) and Strategy (Niti) are also Divine forms.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्
verses.english_translation: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that also am I, O Arjuna. There is no being, moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me.

essence.reflection: Nothing exists without God. If you remove the 'Is-ness' (Existence) from anything, it ceases to be. That 'Is-ness' is God.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया
verses.english_translation: There is no end to My divine glories, O Parantapa; but this is just a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine glory.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know this is just a Glimpse.
essence.reflection: The list is endless. God's glory cannot be fully cataloged; it can only be briefly illustrated.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम्
verses.english_translation: Whatever being there is that is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that to have sprung from a mere spark of My splendor.

essence.reflection: Whenever you see greatness—in an artist, a leader, or nature—don't worship the form; worship the Divine Spark that empowers it.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्
verses.english_translation: But what need is there, O Arjuna, for this detailed knowledge? I stand supporting this whole universe with a single fragment of Myself.

essence.reflection: The entire visible universe is just a fraction of God's power. The Infinite remains largely unmanifest, supporting the manifest with ease.

chapters.title: Vishvarupa Darshana Yoga
chapters.subtitle: The Yoga of the Vision of the Universal Form

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् ।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: By this word of the highest secret concerning the Self, which You have spoken out of compassion for me, my delusion is gone.

essence.reflection: Gratitude is the first response to spiritual clarity. Arjuna acknowledges that the teachings were given out of grace (Anugraha).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: The origin and dissolution of beings have been heard by me in detail from You, O Lotus-eyed One, and also Your inexhaustible greatness.

essence.reflection: Hearing about the Divine glory is the preparation for seeing it. Theory precedes experience.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर ।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम
verses.english_translation: Now, O Supreme Lord, as You have declared Yourself to be, so do I desire to see Your Ishvara-form, O Purushottama.

essence.reflection: Desire to see the Truth (Darshan) is the next step after intellectual conviction. Arjuna asks to move from faith to direct experience.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो ।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: If You think it possible for me to see it, O Lord, Lord of Yoga, then show me Your Imperishable Self.

essence.reflection: Humility in asking is key. Arjuna leaves the decision to Krishna ('If You think it is possible'), acknowledging his own limitations.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Behold, O Partha, My forms, by the hundreds and thousands, of different sorts, divine and of various colors and shapes.

essence.reflection: The Divine is not one static form but infinite multiplicity. God is the explosion of infinite creativity and variety.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा ।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत
verses.english_translation: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Ashvins, and also the Maruts; behold many wonders never seen before, O Bharata.

essence.reflection: The entire pantheon of gods and cosmic forces are just parts of the One Body of the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् ।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि
verses.english_translation: Now behold, O Gudakesha, in this My body, the whole universe centered in the One, including the moving and the unmoving, and whatever else you desire to see.

essence.reflection: The whole universe is contained within the Divine, not outside of it. Past, present, future, and all possibilities exist Here and Now.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा ।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
verses.english_translation: But you cannot see Me with these eyes of yours; I give you the divine eye; behold My sovereign Yoga.

essence.reflection: Physical senses are limited. To see the Truth, one needs a shift in perception—a 'divine eye' granted by Grace.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः ।
दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्
verses.english_translation: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus, O King, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari, showed to Partha His Supreme Divine Form.

essence.reflection: This is the climax of the visual revelation. The Master of Yoga (Yogeshvara) unveils reality.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्
verses.english_translation: With numerous mouths and eyes, with numerous wonderful sights, with numerous divine ornaments, with numerous divine weapons uplifted.

essence.reflection: The Infinite has infinite faces and infinite tools. The vision is overwhelming in its multiplicity.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् ।
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.english_translation: Wearing divine garlands and apparel, anointed with divine unguents, the all-wonderful, resplendent, endless, and facing on all sides.

essence.reflection: The Divine is 'Ananta' (Endless) and 'Vishvatomukham' (Facing everywhere). There is nowhere He is not.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता ।
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः
verses.english_translation: If the splendor of a thousand suns were to blaze out at once in the sky, that would be like the splendor of that Mighty Being.

essence.reflection: The light of the Spirit is blindingly bright, far surpassing any physical light source. It is the Light of lights.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा ।
अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा
verses.english_translation: There, in the body of the God of gods, Pandava then saw the whole universe resting in one, with its manifold divisions.

essence.reflection: Unity in Diversity. The shattered, divided world is seen as a unified whole within the Divine Body.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः ।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.english_translation: Then Dhananjaya, filled with amazement, his hair standing on end, bowed down his head to the God and spoke with joined palms.

essence.reflection: True vision leads to surrender. Arjuna's ego is dwarfed by the cosmic reality, leading to spontaneous reverence.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान् ।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ-
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: I see all the gods, O God, in Your body, and also hosts of various beings, Brahma the Lord seated on his lotus-throne, all the Rishis and the celestial serpents.

essence.reflection: Arjuna confirms the vision: The Creator (Brahma) and the created are all within the Supreme Being.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् ।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप
verses.english_translation: I see Thee with manifold arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes, facing on all sides, of boundless form. I see neither the end, nor the middle, nor the beginning of Thee, O Lord of the Universe, O Universal Form.

essence.reflection: The Cosmic Form shatters the concept of boundaries. There is no 'outside' to God.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च
तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद्
दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्
verses.english_translation: I see Thee crowned, with mace and discus, a mass of radiance, shining everywhere, very hard to look at, blazing all around like burning fire and the sun, immeasurable.

essence.reflection: The intensity of the Divine Truth can be overwhelming, 'hard to look at' (Durnirikshyam), yet undeniable.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे
verses.english_translation: Thou art the Imperishable, the Supreme Being to be known. Thou art the great treasure-house of this universe. Thou art the imperishable Guardian of the Eternal Dharma. Thou art the Primal Person, I deem.

essence.reflection: Arjuna recognizes Krishna as the Guardian of Dharma. The chaotic vision has a moral purpose: the preservation of Order.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्
verses.english_translation: I see Thee without beginning, middle, or end, infinite in power, of endless arms, the sun and moon being Thy eyes, the burning fire Thy mouth, heating the whole universe with Thy radiance.

essence.reflection: The vision shifts from majestic to intense. The Divine is not just light; He is also the Fire that heats (and consumes) the world.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः ।
दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्
verses.english_translation: The space between the heaven and the earth and all the quarters are filled by Thee alone; having seen this, Thy wonderful and terrible form, the three worlds are trembling with fear, O Great-souled One.

essence.reflection: The mood shifts to Fear. The 'Ugra' (Terrible) aspect of the Divine causes the ego to tremble. The vastness is terrifying.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घा विशन्ति
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति ।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः
verses.english_translation: Verily, into Thee enter these hosts of gods; some extol Thee in fear with joined palms; 'May it be well,' saying thus, bands of great Rishis and Siddhas praise Thee with splendid hymns.

essence.reflection: Even the higher beings (gods/sages) approach this Cosmic Form with fear and reverence, praying for wellbeing.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या
विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च ।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे
verses.english_translation: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, the two Ashvins, Maruts, Ushmapas, and hosts of Gandharvas, Yakshas, Asuras, and Siddhas—all look at Thee, in amazement.

essence.reflection: The entire hierarchy of creation is witness to this supreme revelation, united in amazement.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् ।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम्
verses.english_translation: Having seen Thy immeasurable form, with many mouths and eyes, O mighty-armed, with many arms, thighs, and feet, with many stomachs, and fearful with many tusks—the worlds are terrified, and so am I.

essence.reflection: Arjuna confesses his terror. The Divine is not just beautiful; He is also 'Karala' (Terrible/Ferocious). Realizing this totality is shattering.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् ।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो
verses.english_translation: On seeing Thee touching the sky, shining in many colors, with mouths wide open, with large fiery eyes, I am terrified at heart, and find no courage nor peace, O Vishnu.

essence.reflection: When the Ego faces the Infinite, it loses its balance (Shama). The finite cannot comfortably behold the Infinite without preparation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि ।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
verses.english_translation: Having seen Thy mouths, fearful with tusks, blazing like Pralaya-fires, I know not the four quarters, nor do I find peace; be gracious, O Lord of the gods, O Abode of the Universe.

essence.reflection: Arjuna feels disoriented ('I know not the directions'). In the face of Cosmic Dissolution, the only refuge is Prayer.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः ।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः
verses.english_translation: All the sons of Dhritarashtra with hosts of kings of the earth, Bhishma, Drona, and Sutaputra (Karna), with the warrior chiefs of ours...

essence.reflection: Arjuna sees the specific future of the war: the death of the key players.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति
दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि ।
केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु
सन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः
verses.english_translation: ...Are entering hurriedly into Thy mouths, fearful with tusks; some are found sticking between Thy teeth with their heads crushed to powder.

essence.reflection: This graphic vision of destruction represents Time (Kala) consuming all beings. It is the unavoidable reality of mortality.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः
समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति ।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा
विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति
verses.english_translation: As many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so do these heroes in the world of men enter Your flaming mouths.

essence.reflection: Death is the ocean where all rivers of life inevitably end. The flow is natural and unstoppable.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः ।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका-
स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः
verses.english_translation: As moths rush with great speed into a blazing fire to perish, even so do these creatures rush into Your mouths with great speed only to perish.

essence.reflection: There is a compulsion in destiny. Like moths to a flame, beings are drawn towards their own karmic conclusion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्-
लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः ।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो
verses.english_translation: Swallowing all the worlds on every side with Thy flaming mouths, Thou are licking Thy lips. Thy fierce rays, filling the whole world with radiance, are burning it, O Vishnu!

essence.reflection: The Divine is the All-Devourer. This aspect is terrifying to the ego which wants to exist forever.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद ।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्
verses.english_translation: Tell me, who are You, so fierce in form? I bow down to You, O God Supreme; have mercy. I desire to know You, the Primal One. I know not Your purpose.

essence.reflection: Arjuna asks the ultimate question: 'Who are You?' faced with the raw power of nature/God.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः ।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: I am Time (Death), the destroyer of the worlds, matured, come here to destroy the world. Even without you, of all the warriors standing in the hostile armies, none shall survive.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that I am Time (Kala), the Destroyer.
essence.reflection: The outcome is already decided by the Cosmic Will. The ego's belief that 'I am saving' or 'I am killing' is an illusion. Time kills all.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व
जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् ।
मयैवैते नहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्
verses.english_translation: Therefore, arise and obtain fame. Conquer the enemies and enjoy the unrivaled kingdom. By Me have they been already slain; be Thou a mere instrument, O Savyasachin.

essence.reflection: Since the Divine Will has already ordained the result, your role is simply to be the willing instrument. Act without the burden of doership.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
कर्णं तथान्यानपि योधवीरान् ।
मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा
युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्
verses.english_translation: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors—these are already killed by Me; do You kill; be not distressed with fear; fight and You shall conquer Your enemies in battle.

essence.reflection: The mental hesitation is removed when you realize you are executing a Divine Decree, not a personal vendetta. Victory is assured.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी ।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य
verses.english_translation: Sanjaya said: Having heard that speech of Keshava, the crowned one (Arjuna), with joined palms, trembling, prostrating himself, again addressed Krishna in a choked voice, bowing down, overwhelmed with fear.

essence.reflection: Arjuna's response shifts from confusion to total submission and fear. The ego is completely subdued by the revelation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या
जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च ।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: It is meet, O Hrishikesha, that the world delights and rejoices in Your praise; Rakshasas fly in fear to all quarters, and all the hosts of Siddhas bow to You.

essence.reflection: Arjuna acknowledges the rightness of the cosmic order: joy for the devotees, fear for the demons. God is everything to everyone.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे ।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्
verses.english_translation: And why should they not bow to You, O Great-souled One, greater than Brahma, the Primal Cause? O Infinite Being, O Lord of gods, O Abode of the Universe, You are the Imperishable, the Being and the non-Being, and That which is beyond both.

essence.reflection: God is 'Sat' (Manifest), 'Asat' (Unmanifest), and that which is beyond both. He is the ultimate Reality.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण-
स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप
verses.english_translation: You are the Primal God, the Ancient Purusha; You are the Supreme Refuge of this universe. You are the Knower, the Knowable, and the Supreme Abode. By You is the universe pervaded, O Being of infinite forms.

essence.reflection: Arjuna praises the Omniscience (Knower) and Omnipresence (Pervader) of the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः
प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च ।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते
verses.english_translation: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the Moon, Prajapati, and the Great-Grandfather. Salutations, salutations unto You a thousand times, and again salutations, salutations unto You.

essence.reflection: Overwhelmed by devotion, the only response is surrender. 'Namas' (Not mine, but Yours) is repeated infinitely.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व ।
अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं
सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः
verses.english_translation: Salutations to You from before and from behind; salutations to You on every side, O All! Infinite in power and infinite in prowess, You pervade all; wherefore You are All.

essence.reflection: God is Everything. 'Tato-si Sarvah' - Therefore, You are All. There is no direction or place where God is not.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति ।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि
verses.english_translation: Whatever I have rashly said from carelessness or love, addressing You as 'O Krishna, O Yadava, O Friend,' looking on You merely as a friend, ignorant of this Your greatness...

essence.reflection: Arjuna realizes his familiarity with God was based on ignorance of His true power. He apologizes for treating the Infinite as a mere mortal friend.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि
विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु ।
एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं
तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्
verses.english_translation: ...In whatever way I may have insulted You for the sake of fun, while at play, reposing, sitting, or at meals, when alone (with You), O Achyuta, or in company—that I implore You, Immeasurable One, to forgive.

essence.reflection: Repentance purifies the relationship. Seeing the Divine majesty makes one realize the insignificance of the ego's casual behavior.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य
त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् ।
न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो
लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव
verses.english_translation: You are the Father of this world, moving and unmoving. You are to be adored by this world, You the Greatest Guru; there is none equal to You; how can there be another superior to You in the three worlds, O Being of unequalled power?

essence.reflection: Krishna is acknowledged as the 'Guru of Gurus' (Gurur Gariyan). He is the ultimate authority.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम् ।
पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः
प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्
verses.english_translation: Therefore, bowing down, prostrating my body, I crave Your forgiveness, O Adorable Lord. As a father forgives his son, a friend his friend, a lover his beloved, even so should You forgive me, O God.

essence.reflection: Arjuna appeals to the personal relationship (Father, Friend, Lover) to seek tolerance for his mistakes. The Divine is intimate.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा
भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे ।
तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
verses.english_translation: I am delighted, having seen what was never seen before; and yet my mind is distressed with fear. Show me that form only, O God; have mercy, O Lord of Gods, O Abode of the Universe.

essence.reflection: Arjuna is honest: the Cosmic Form is too intense. He asks to return to a form he can relate to with love, not just fear.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तं
इच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव ।
तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन
सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते
verses.english_translation: I desire to see You as before, crowned, bearing a mace, with a discus in the hand, in Your former form only, having four arms, O Thousand-armed, O Universal Form.

essence.reflection: Arjuna seeks the familiar, personal form of God (Vishnu/Krishna) which represents order and grace, rather than the chaotic Universal form.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् ।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: O Arjuna, by My grace, through My own Yoga power, I have shown you this supreme form, resplendent, universal, infinite, and primeval, which none but you has ever seen.

essence.reflection: The vision was a gift, not a right. It was shown because of Krishna's pleasure (Prasannena) with Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै-
र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः ।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहम् नृलोके
द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर
verses.english_translation: Neither by the study of the Vedas and sacrifices, nor by gifts, nor by rituals, nor by severe austerities, can I be seen in this form in the world of men by any other than you, O great hero of the Kurus.

essence.krishna_guidance: Understand the Rarity of this vision.
essence.reflection: Scholarly study and severe penance are insufficient to see God's true nature. Only Grace opens this door.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् ।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य
verses.english_translation: Be not afraid, nor bewildered on seeing such a terrible form of Mine as this; with your fear dispelled and with a gladdened heart, now behold again this former form of Mine.

essence.reflection: Krishna comforts Arjuna. He withdraws the terrifying aspect to restore intimacy and peace. The goal of God is love, not terror.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः ।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा
verses.english_translation: Sanjaya said: Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Vasudeva again showed His own form; and the Great Soul, assuming His gentle form, consoled him who was terrified.

essence.reflection: The Divine returns to the 'Saumya-vapuh' (Gentle Form). This is the form accessible for relationship and dialogue.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन ।
इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: Having seen this Your gentle human form, O Janardana, I am now composed and restored to my own nature.

essence.reflection: Peace returns when we see God in a relatable way. The human form of the Avatar is a bridge to the Infinite.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम ।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Very hard indeed it is to see this form of Mine which you have seen. Even the gods are ever longing to behold it.

essence.reflection: Even celestial beings yearn for the direct experience of Truth. Human life offers a unique opportunity for this realization.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया ।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा
verses.english_translation: Neither by the Vedas, nor by austerity, nor by gift, nor by sacrifice, can I be seen in this form as you have seen Me.

essence.reflection: Rituals and austerities purify, but they cannot force the Divine to reveal Itself. Revelation is an act of Grace.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप
verses.english_translation: But by single-minded devotion can I, of this form, be known and seen in reality and also entered into, O Parantapa.

essence.reflection: This is the secret key. Only Love (Bhakti) allows one to Know, See, and Merge with the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः ।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव
verses.english_translation: He who does all actions for Me, who looks upon Me as the Supreme, who is devoted to Me, who is free from attachment, who bears enmity towards no creature, he comes to Me, O Pandava.

essence.krishna_guidance: Work for Me, Be Devoted to Me.
essence.reflection: This verse sums up the entire Gita: Dedicate work to God, make God the goal, remove attachment, and have no enemies. This guarantees liberation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते ।
ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: Those devotees who, ever steadfast, thus worship You, and those also who worship the Imperishable and the Unmanifest—which of them are better versed in Yoga?

essence.reflection: The seeker often wonders: Is it better to love a personal God (Form) or meditate on the Abstract Reality (Formless)? Both are valid, but one is easier.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ।
श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Those who, fixing their minds on Me, worship Me, ever steadfast and endowed with supreme faith, these in My opinion are the best in Yoga.

essence.krishna_guidance: Fix your mind on Me (The Personal Form).
essence.reflection: Bhakti (Devotion) is considered the most perfect yoga because it engages the heart, mind, and faith in a direct relationship with the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते ।
सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यञ्च कूटस्थमचलन्ध्रुवम्
verses.english_translation: But those who worship the Imperishable, the Indefinable, the Unmanifest, the Omnipresent, the Unthinkable, the Unchangeable, the Immovable, and the Eternal...

essence.krishna_guidance: Acknowledge the path of the Formless.
essence.reflection: Worshipping the Abstract (Akshara/Avyakta) requires high intellectual discipline. It is the path of Jnana Yoga.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः ।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.english_translation: ...Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, rejoicing in the welfare of all beings—they also come to Me indeed.

essence.krishna_guidance: Be Even-minded (Samabuddhayah) and kind to all.
essence.reflection: The goal of the Formless path is the same—union with the Divine—but it demands strict control and universal compassion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् ।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते
verses.english_translation: The trouble is greater for those whose minds are set on the Unmanifest; for the goal, the Unmanifest, is very hard for the embodied to reach.

essence.krishna_guidance: Understand the Difficulty of the Formless path.
essence.reflection: It is hard for an embodied being (someone with a body) to relate to something without a body. Bhakti is easier and more natural.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः ।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते
verses.english_translation: But those who worship Me, renouncing all actions in Me, regarding Me as the Supreme Goal, meditating on Me with single-minded Yoga...

essence.reflection: Make God the center of your life. Let every action be an offering, and every thought a meditation on Him.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् ।
भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्
verses.english_translation: ...For them, whose minds are set on Me, verily I become, ere long, O Partha, the Savior out of the ocean of fatal Samsara.

essence.reflection: Have faith. If you fix your mind on the Divine, He personally takes responsibility for pulling you out of the ocean of death.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय ।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः
verses.english_translation: Fix your mind on Me only, place your intellect in Me; then, you shall no doubt live in Me alone.

essence.reflection: Total immersion: When both emotion (mind) and reason (intellect) are aligned with God, you live in a divine state.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् ।
अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय
verses.english_translation: If you are unable to fix your mind steadily on Me, then by the Yoga of constant practice seek to reach Me, O Dhananjaya.

essence.reflection: If you can't focus instantly, don't give up. Practice repeatedly withdrawing the mind and placing it back on the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव ।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि
verses.english_translation: If you are unable even to practice Abhyasa Yoga, be intent on doing actions for My sake; even by doing actions for My sake, you shall attain perfection.

essence.reflection: If meditation is too hard, just dedicate your daily work to God. Make your job your worship.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्
verses.english_translation: If you are unable to do even this, then taking refuge in union with Me, renounce the fruits of all actions with the self controlled.

essence.reflection: If you can't even dedicate the work to God, simply stop worrying about the result. Let go of the outcome.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते ।
ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्
verses.english_translation: Better indeed is knowledge than practice; than knowledge, meditation is better; than meditation, the renunciation of the fruit of action; peace immediately follows renunciation.

essence.reflection: Letting go of expectations is the fastest button for peace. It is superior because it destroys the root of anxiety immediately.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी
verses.english_translation: He who hates no creature, who is friendly and compassionate to all, who is free from attachment and egoism, balanced in pleasure and pain, and forgiving...

essence.reflection: A true devotee has no enemies. They live with a heart full of friendship and forgiveness, free from ego.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.english_translation: ...Ever content, steady in meditation, self-controlled, possessed of firm conviction, with the mind and intellect dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

essence.reflection: The most lovable quality in a devotee is contentment. God loves those who are happy with whatever He gives.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः ।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः
verses.english_translation: He by whom the world is not agitated and who cannot be agitated by the world, and who is freed from joy, envy, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to Me.

essence.reflection: A spiritual person is a safe space. They do not disturb the world, and they do not let the world disturb them.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.english_translation: He who is free from wants, pure, expert, unconcerned, and untroubled, renouncing all undertakings or commencements—he who is (thus) devoted to Me, is dear to Me.

essence.reflection: Devotion doesn't mean incompetence. A devotee is efficient yet unconcerned about the outcome, pure in intent.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः
verses.english_translation: He who neither rejoices, nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires, renouncing good and evil, and who is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

essence.reflection: Rise above the duality of 'good luck' and 'bad luck'. Accept everything as God's will without emotional reaction.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः ।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः
verses.english_translation: He who is the same to foe and friend, and also in honor and dishonor, who is the same in cold and heat and in pleasure and pain, who is free from attachment...

essence.krishna_guidance: Be Same (Samah) to Friend and Foe.
essence.reflection: Equanimity is the gold standard. Treating praise and insult with the same calmness proves that the ego is dissolved.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् ।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः
verses.english_translation: ...To whom censure and praise are equal, who is silent, content with anything, homeless, of a steady mind, and full of devotion—that man is dear to Me.

essence.reflection: Whether you have a palace or no roof, do not be attached to 'home'. Find your security in the Divine, not in walls.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते ।
श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः
verses.english_translation: They indeed who follow this Immortal Dharma (Law of Life) as described above, endowed with faith, regarding Me as their Supreme Goal, they, the devotees, are exceedingly dear to Me.

essence.reflection: Those who live by these values of equanimity and devotion are not just dear; they are 'Exceedingly Dear' (Ativa-me-priyah) to God.

chapters.title: Kshetra Kshetrajna Vibhaga Yoga
chapters.subtitle: The Yoga of Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च ।
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: Prakriti (Nature) and Purusha (Spirit), the Field and the Knower of the Field, Knowledge and that which ought to be known—these I wish to learn, O Keshava.

essence.reflection: To solve the puzzle of life, one must first distinguish the pieces: What is me? What is not me? What is knowledge?

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते ।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: This body, O Kaunteya, is called the Field (Kshetra); he who knows it is called the Knower of the Field (Kshetrajna) by those who know of them.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know the Body is just a Field.
essence.reflection: You are the farmer (Knower); the body is the farm (Field). You cultivate it, but you are not the dirt you walk on.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम
verses.english_translation: And know Me as the Knower of the Field in all fields, O Bharata. The knowledge of the Field and its Knower is considered by Me to be true knowledge.

essence.krishna_guidance: See Me as the Knower in everyone.
essence.reflection: There is only one Conscious Viewer looking out through billions of pairs of eyes. To know this distinction is true wisdom.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् ।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु
verses.english_translation: What that Field is, of what nature, what are its modifications, whence it is, and what He (the Knower) is and what His powers are, hear that from Me in brief.

essence.krishna_guidance: Listen to the Summary of existence.
essence.reflection: Understanding the mechanics of reality (the Field) and the majesty of the Spirit (the Knower) is the foundation of freedom.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् ।
ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः
verses.english_translation: Rishis have sung in many ways, in various chants and in decisive Brahma-Sutra verses full of reasoning.

essence.reflection: This truth isn't a new invention; it is the conclusion of logical analysis (Brahma Sutra) and intuitive vision (Rishis).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च ।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः
verses.english_translation: The great elements, Egoism, Intellect, and also the Unmanifest, the ten senses and one (mind), and the five objects of the senses...

essence.krishna_guidance: Analyze the Components of the Field.
essence.reflection: Everything you interact with—including your own mind and ego—is just 'matter' or 'content'. It is not You.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतना धृतिः ।
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्
verses.english_translation: ...Desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate (body), intelligence, and steadfastness—the Field has been thus briefly described with its modifications.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know that Emotions are part of the Field.
essence.reflection: Even your feelings (Desire/Hatred) and intelligence are objects of observation. They belong to the Field, not the Knower.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् ।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः
verses.english_translation: Humility, modesty, non-injury, forgiveness, uprightness, service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, self-control...

essence.reflection: Knowledge is defined as 'Virtue'. Without qualities like humility and self-control, intellectual data is just arrogance.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च ।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्
verses.english_translation: ...Dispassion towards sense objects, absence of ego, and perception of the evil of birth, death, old age, sickness, and pain...

essence.reflection: Realism is seeing that physical existence is inherently painful (birth, aging, sickness). This insight leads to detachment.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु ।
नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु
verses.english_translation: ...Non-attachment, non-identification with son, wife, home, etc., and constant equanimity on the attainment of the desirable and the undesirable...

essence.reflection: Love your family, but don't be glued to them. Keep your balance whether things go your way or not.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी ।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि
verses.english_translation: ...Unswerving devotion unto Me by the Yoga of non-separation, resort to solitary places, distaste for the society of men...

essence.reflection: True knowledge includes Bhakti. Solitude helps recharge, while mindless socializing drains the spiritual battery.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् ।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा
verses.english_translation: ...Constancy in Self-knowledge, perception of the end of true knowledge; this is declared to be 'Knowledge', and what is opposed to it is ignorance.

essence.reflection: Information about the world is ignorance. Insight into the Self and the purpose of life is the only real Knowledge.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते ।
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते
verses.english_translation: I will declare that which has to be known, knowing which one attains immortality; the beginningless Supreme Brahman, called neither being nor non-being.

essence.reflection: The Ultimate Reality is beyond logic. It is not 'existing' like a pot, nor 'non-existing' like a sky-flower. It is beyond definitions.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.english_translation: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and mouths everywhere, with ears everywhere, He exists in the world, enveloping all.

essence.reflection: Every hand that works is empowered by Him; every eye that sees is lit by Him. He pervades the universe like space.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् ।
असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च
verses.english_translation: Shining by the functions of all the senses, yet without the senses; unattached, yet supporting all; devoid of qualities, yet their experiencer.

essence.reflection: He sees without eyes and works without hands. He supports everything but is attached to nothing. He enjoys life but has no needs.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च ।
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्
verses.english_translation: Without and within (all) beings, the unmoving and also the moving; because of His subtlety, He is incomprehensible; He is far and also near.

essence.reflection: He is the atom and the galaxy. He is inside you (nearest) but unknown to the ego (farthest).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् ।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च
verses.english_translation: He is undivided, yet He exists as if divided in beings; He is to be known as the Supporter of beings; He devours and He generates.

essence.krishna_guidance: See the Undivided in the Divided.
essence.reflection: Like the ocean water in many waves, the One Consciousness appears as many souls. He creates, sustains, and destroys.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते ।
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्
verses.english_translation: That, the Light of all lights, is said to be beyond darkness; Knowledge, the Object of Knowledge, and the Goal of Knowledge, seated in the hearts of all.

essence.reflection: The sun lights the world, but what lights the mind to see the sun? That inner Consciousness is the ultimate Illuminator.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः ।
मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते
verses.english_translation: Thus the Field, as well as Knowledge and the Object of Knowledge, have been briefly stated. My devotee, knowing this, enters into My Being.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know this to attain My Being.
essence.reflection: Knowledge isn't just for satisfying curiosity; its purpose is transformation. Knowing these truths leads to merging with the Divine.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि ।
विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान्
verses.english_translation: Know that Nature (Prakriti) and Spirit (Purusha) are both beginningless; and know also that all modifications and qualities are born of Nature.

essence.reflection: The hardware (Prakriti) changes and evolves. The user (Purusha) is eternal. Do not blame the user for the hardware's glitches.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते ।
पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते
verses.english_translation: In the production of the body and the senses, Nature is said to be the cause; in the experience of pleasure and pain, the Soul is said to be the cause.

essence.reflection: Nature provides the machinery for action. The Soul provides the capacity to feel and experience the results.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् ।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु
verses.english_translation: The Soul seated in Nature experiences the qualities born of Nature; attachment to the qualities is the cause of his birth in good and evil wombs.

essence.reflection: The Soul is like a passenger in the car of Nature. If the passenger falls in love with the car's speed or comfort, he gets stuck in the journey.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः ।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः
verses.english_translation: The Supreme Purusha in this body is also called the Spectator, the Permitter, the Supporter, the Enjoyer, the Great Lord, and the Supreme Self.

essence.reflection: You are not the doer; you are the Permitter and Witness. Realizing this distance from action gives you mastery (Maheshwara) over it.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते
verses.english_translation: He who thus knows the Spirit and Nature, together with the qualities, in whatever condition he may be, he is not reborn.

essence.krishna_guidance: Know the Distinction to escape Rebirth.
essence.reflection: Once you see the separation between the Observer (You) and the Movie (Life), you are free. The movie can't trap you anymore.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना ।
अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे
verses.english_translation: Some by meditation behold the Self in the Self by the Self, others by the Yoga of Knowledge, and others by the Yoga of Action.

essence.reflection: Meditation, Analysis, or Work—all are valid telescopes to view the same Moon (Self).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते ।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः
verses.english_translation: Others also, not knowing thus, worship, having heard of It from others; they, too, cross beyond death, regarding what they have heard as the supreme refuge.

essence.reflection: Even if you don't understand everything, simply listening to the wise and following with faith can save you. Good company (Satsang) is a lifeboat.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ
verses.english_translation: Wherever a being is born, whether unmoving or moving, know thou, O best of the Bharatas, that it is from the union of the Field and the Knower of the Field.

essence.reflection: Life is the spark that happens when Spirit touches Matter. Every living thing is a miracle of this union.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् ।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.english_translation: He sees, who sees the Supreme Lord existing equally in all beings, the Imperishable within the perishable.

essence.krishna_guidance: See the Imperishable in the Perishable.
essence.reflection: The body dies; the Life within does not. Seeing this continuity is true vision (Samyak Darshana).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् ।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.english_translation: Indeed, seeing the same Lord equally dwelling everywhere, he does not destroy the Self by the self; therefore, he goes to the highest goal.

essence.reflection: Ignoring the Divine within yourself and others is spiritual suicide. Seeing God everywhere is the path to life.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
प्रकृत्याैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः ।
यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति
verses.english_translation: He sees, who sees that all actions are performed by Nature alone and that the Self is actionless.

essence.reflection: The movie plays on the screen, but the screen doesn't act. You are the screen. Nature is the movie.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति ।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा
verses.english_translation: When he perceives the diversified existence of beings as rooted in One, and spreading forth from That alone, then he attains Brahman.

essence.reflection: Diversity is surface-level; Unity is the root. When you trace all variety back to the One Source, you are Enlightened.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः ।
शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते
verses.english_translation: Being without beginning and devoid of (Nature's) qualities, the Supreme Self, imperishable, though dwelling in the body, O Kaunteya, neither acts nor is tainted.

essence.reflection: Just as space holds trash but doesn't become dirty, the Soul holds the body but is never stained by its actions.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते ।
सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते
verses.english_translation: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted because of its subtlety, so the Self seated everywhere in the body is not tainted.

essence.reflection: The finer thing pervades the grosser thing without being affected. Spirit is the subtlest of all, hence it remains pure.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः ।
क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत
verses.english_translation: Just as the one sun illumines the whole world, so also the Lord of the Field (Self) illumines the whole Field, O Bharata.

essence.reflection: You are the consciousness that lights up your world. Without you (the witness), your world would not exist for you.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्
verses.english_translation: They who, by the eye of knowledge, perceive the distinction between the Field and the Knower of the Field, and also the liberation of the being from Nature, go to the Supreme.

essence.reflection: Freedom comes from knowing the difference between the Cage (Nature) and the Bird (Self). Once you see the door, you can fly.

chapters.title: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
chapters.subtitle: The Yoga of the Three Modes of Material Nature

verses.sanskrit_verse:
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: I will again declare that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have attained supreme perfection after this life.

essence.reflection: Knowledge is the ultimate liberator. This isn't just information; it is the tool used by sages to escape the limits of mortal life.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः ।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च
verses.english_translation: They who, having taken refuge in this knowledge, have attained to unity with Me, are neither born at the time of creation nor are they disturbed at the time of dissolution.

essence.reflection: The goal is to become like the Divine—eternal and unaffected by the cosmic cycles of big bangs and crunches.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम् ।
सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत
verses.english_translation: My womb is the great Brahma (Nature); in that I place the germ; thence, O Bharata, is the birth of all beings.

essence.reflection: Creation is not an accident; it is the union of Spirit (Father) and Matter (Mother). God impregnates Nature with life.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः ।
तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता
verses.english_translation: Whatever forms are produced, O Kaunteya, in any womb whatsoever, the great Brahma (Nature) is their womb, and I am the seed-giving Father.

essence.reflection: Every species and form shares the same Mother (Nature) and the same Father (God). We are all kin.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः ।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्
verses.english_translation: Sattva, Rajas, Tamas—these Gunas, O mighty-armed, born of Nature, bind fast in the body the embodied, the indestructible.

essence.reflection: The soul is free, but it is tied to the body by three ropes: Goodness (Sattva), Passion (Rajas), and Ignorance (Tamas).

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् ।
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ
verses.english_translation: Of these, Sattva, which from its stainlessness is luminous and healthy, binds by attachment to happiness and by attachment to knowledge, O sinless one.

essence.reflection: Even good things can trap you. Being addicted to knowledge or feeling 'good' is still a golden chain that binds the soul to the world.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् ।
तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्
verses.english_translation: Know Rajas to be of the nature of passion, the source of thirst and attachment; it binds the embodied, O Kaunteya, by attachment to action.

essence.reflection: The endless drive to 'do more' and 'get more' is the fever of Rajas. It binds you to the treadmill of action and reaction.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत
verses.english_translation: But know Tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings; it binds fast, O Bharata, by heedlessness, indolence, and sleep.

essence.reflection: Laziness, excessive sleep, and negligence are not just bad habits; they are spiritual chains forged by Tamas.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत ।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत
verses.english_translation: Sattva attaches to happiness, Rajas to action, O Bharata, while Tamas, shrouding knowledge, attaches to heedlessness.

essence.reflection: Are you driven by joy (Sattva), ambition (Rajas), or carelessness (Tamas)? Identify the rope that pulls you.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत ।
रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा
verses.english_translation: Now Sattva prevails, having overpowered Rajas and Tamas, O Bharata; now Rajas, having overpowered Sattva and Tamas; and now Tamas, having overpowered Sattva and Rajas.

essence.reflection: Your mood swings are just the Gunas fighting for dominance. You are the battlefield, not the combatants.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते ।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत
verses.english_translation: When through every gate (sense) in this body, the wisdom-light shines, then it may be known that Sattva is predominant.

essence.reflection: When you perceive things clearly and your senses are alert yet calm, know that you are in a state of Sattva.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा ।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ
verses.english_translation: Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, longing—these arise when Rajas is predominant, O best of the Bharatas.

essence.reflection: If you feel restless, greedy, or compelled to be constantly busy, realize that Passion (Rajas) has taken over.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च ।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन
verses.english_translation: Darkness, inertness, heedlessness, and delusion—these arise when Tamas is predominant, O descendant of Kuru.

essence.reflection: Confusion, depression, and an inability to act are symptoms of Tamas. Do not mistake them for relaxation.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् ।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते
verses.english_translation: If the embodied one meets death when Sattva is predominant, then he attains to the spotless worlds of the Knowers of the Highest.

essence.reflection: The state of mind at death determines the trajectory of the soul. Cultivating goodness ensures a higher destination.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते ।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते
verses.english_translation: Meeting death in Rajas, he is born among those attached to action; and dying in Tamas, he is born in the womb of the senseless.

essence.krishna_guidance: Avoid death in Rajas and Tamas.
essence.reflection: Dying with unfulfilled desires leads back to the treadmill of work. Dying in ignorance leads to spiritual regression.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् ।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्
verses.english_translation: The fruit of good action, they say, is Sattvic and pure; verily, the fruit of Rajas is pain, and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance.

essence.reflection: Good actions bring peace. Passionate actions bring pain (eventually). Ignorant actions bring confusion.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च
verses.english_translation: From Sattva arises wisdom, and greed from Rajas; heedlessness and error arise from Tamas, and also ignorance.

essence.reflection: If you feel wise, it's Sattva. If you feel greedy, it's Rajas. If you feel confused, it's Tamas. Know the cause.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः ।
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः
verses.english_translation: Those who are established in Sattva go upwards; the Rajasic dwell in the middle; and the Tamasic, abiding in the function of the lowest Guna, go downwards.

essence.reflection: Evolution is vertical. You can rise to divinity, stay human, or fall to brutality depending on which Guna you cultivate.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति ।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति
verses.english_translation: When the seer beholds no agent other than the Gunas and knows That which is higher than the Gunas, he attains to My Being.

essence.krishna_guidance: See the Gunas as the Doers.
essence.reflection: You are not doing anything. The modes of nature are interacting with the modes of nature. Realize this and be free.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् ।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते
verses.english_translation: The embodied one, having crossed beyond these three Gunas out of which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay, and pain, and attains to immortality.

essence.reflection: Immortality is not living forever in a body; it is rising above the biological software (Gunas) that runs the body.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो ।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: What are the marks of him who has crossed over the three Gunas, O Lord? What is his conduct, and how does he go beyond these three Gunas?

essence.reflection: Arjuna asks for the signs of a liberated soul to know what benchmark to aim for.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव ।
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Light, activity, and delusion—when they are present, O Pandava, he hates them not, nor does he long for them when they are absent.

essence.krishna_guidance: Neither Hate nor Crave the Gunas.
essence.reflection: If you feel energetic (Rajas), don't hate it. If you feel dull (Tamas), don't hate it. Watch the weather of the mind without getting wet.

verses.sanskrit_verse:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचालयते ।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते
